description: Also at 1st level, you gain the ability to access the memories of the deceased. By performing a 1 minute ritual on a corpse, you can gain insight into how that creature died. If you already witnessed that creature's death, you instead gain another random memory from that creature, as determined by your DM. This feature can only be used once per corpse.

6.name: Ghostly Body
description: At 6th level, your body can slowly fade into invisibility. If you remain still for 1 minute while in dim light or darkness, you become invisible until you move, enter bright light, or use an action, bonus action, or reaction.
Alternatively, you can use your bonus action and spend 2 sorcery points to activate this feature without waiting a minute, causing you to immediately become invisible.

14.name: Incorporeal Figure
description: Starting at 14th level, you have the ability to become temporarily incorporeal. As a bonus action on your turn, you can spend 3 sorcery points to become incorporeal, gaining the ability to move through objects as if the objects were difficult terrain, and you become immune to the grappled and restrained conditions. For the duration, your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks, and your speed is increased by 15 feet.
The incorporeal effect ends at the end of your next turn. If you are inside an object when the effect ends, you are ejected to the nearest empty space and take 1d10 force damage.

18.name: Possession
description: At 18th level, you gain the ability to take control of another creature's body. As an action, you can spend 7 sorcery points to attempt to possess a creature of size Large or smaller within 5 feet of you. That creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Arcane spell save DC or be possessed for up to 1 hour. On a success, you then disappear, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body, but not its awareness. While you are possessing a creature, you can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and you retain your alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You otherwise use the possessed target's statistics, but you doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features such as spellcasting and extra attack, or proficiencies such as skills and armor.

The possessed creature can repeat the saving throw whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on a success. You may also end the effect using your bonus action. A target is immune to this feature for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

subclasses.name: Deathtouched

description: Sometimes the spark of magic that fuels a sorcerer comes from a divine source that glimmers within the soul. Having such a blessed soul is a sign that your innate magic might come from a distant but powerful familial connection to a divine being. Perhaps your ancestor was an angel, transformed into a mortal and sent to fight in a god's name. Or your birth might align with an ancient prophecy, marking you as a servant of the gods or a chosen vessel of divine magic.

A Divine Soul, with natural magnetism, is seen as a threat by some religious hierarchies. As an outsider who commands celestial power, these sorcerers can undermine the existing order by claiming a direct tie to the divine.

In some cultures, only those who can claim the power of a Divine Soul may command religious power. In these lands, ecclesiastical positions are dominated by a few bloodlines and preserved over generations.

1.name: Bonus Spell List
description: Your link to the divine allows you to learn spells normally associated with the cleric class. When your Sorcery feature lets you learn a cantrip or a spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose the new spell from the Divine spell list or the Arcane spell list. You must otherwise obey all the restrictions for selecting the spell.

1.name: Favored by the Gods
description: Starting at 1st level, divine power guards your destiny. If you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, you can roll 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

6.name: Empowered Healing
description: Starting at 6th level, the divine energy coursing through you can empower healing spells. Whenever you or an ally within 5 feet of you rolls dice to determine the number of hit points a spell restores, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any number of those dice once, provided you aren't incapacitated. You can use this feature only once per turn.

14.name: Angelic Form
description: Starting at 14th level, you can use a bonus action to manifest a pair of spectral wings from your back. While the wings are present, you have a flying speed of 30 feet. The wings last until you're incapacitated, you die, or you dismiss them as a bonus action.

18.name: Unearthly Recovery
description: At 18th level, you gain the ability to overcome grievous injuries. As a bonus action when you have fewer than half of your hit points remaining, you can regain a number of hit points equal to half your hit point maximum.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclasses.name: Divine Soul

description: Your innate magic comes from draconic magic that was mingled with your blood or that of your ancestors. Most often, sorcerers with this origin trace their descent back to a mighty sorcerer of ancient times who made a bargain with a dragon or who might even have claimed a dragon parent. Some of these bloodlines are well established in the world, but most are obscure. Any given sorcerer could be the first of a new bloodline, as a result of a pact or some other exceptional circumstance.

1.name: Dragon Ancestor
description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later. In addition, you learn a single cantrip determined by your ancestry which is considered an arcane spell for you.

traits.name: Black Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is acid and you learn the Acid Splash cantrip.

traits.name: Blue Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is lightning and you learn the Spark cantrip.

traits.name: Green Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is poison and you learn the Poison Spray cantrip.

traits.name: Red Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is fire and you learn the Fire Bolt cantrip.

traits.name: White Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is cold and you learn the Frostbite cantrip.

traits.name: Amethyst Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is force and you learn the Force Bolt cantrip.

traits.name: Diamond Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is radiant and you learn the Sacred Flame cantrip.

traits.name: Emerald Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is psychic and you learn the Mind Sliver cantrip.

traits.name: Moonstone Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is radiant and you learn the Sacred Flame cantrip.

traits.name: Obsidian Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is fire and you learn the Fire Bolt cantrip.

traits.name: Ruby Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is fire and you learn the Fire Bolt cantrip.

traits.name: Sapphire Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is thunder and you learn the Sonic Boom cantrip.

traits.name: Topaz Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is necrotic and you learn the Chill Touch cantrip.

traits.name: Brass Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is fire and you learn the Fire Bolt cantrip.

traits.name: Bronze Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is lightning and you learn the Spark cantrip.

traits.name: Copper Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is acid and you learn the Acid Splash cantrip.

traits.name: Gold Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is fire and you learn the Fire Bolt cantrip.

traits.name: Platinum Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is radiant and you learn the Sacred Flame cantrip.

traits.name: Silver Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is cold and you learn the Frostbite cantrip.

traits.name: Steel Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is poison and you learn the Poison Spray cantrip.

traits.name: Tungsten Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is thunder and you learn the Sonic Boom cantrip.

traits.name: Deep Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is psychic and you learn the Mind Sliver cantrip.

traits.name: Shadow Dragon Ancestor
description: Your draconic damage type is necrotic and you learn the Chill Touch cantrip.

1.name: Draconic Resilience
description: As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class.
Additionally, parts of your skin are covered by a thin sheen of dragon-like scales. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

6.name: Elemental Affinity
description: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, add your spellcasting ability modifier to one damage roll of that spell. At the same time, you can spend 2 sorcery points to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

14.name: Dragon Wings
description: At 14th level, you gain the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. You can create these wings as a bonus action on your turn. They last until you dismiss them as a bonus action on your turn.
You can't manifest your wings while wearing armor unless the armor is made to accommodate them, and clothing not made to accommodate your wings might be destroyed when you manifest them.

18.name: Draconic Presence
description: Beginning at 18th level, you can channel the dread presence of your dragon ancestor, causing those around you to become awestruck or frightened. As an action, you can spend 7 sorcery points to draw on this power and exude an aura of awe or fear (your choice) to a distance of 60 feet. For 1 minute or until you lose your concentration (as if you were casting a concentration spell), each hostile creature that starts its turn in this aura must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed (if you chose awe) or frightened (if you chose fear) until the aura ends. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to your aura for 24 hours.

subclasses.name: Draconic Bloodline

description: Wicked magic courses through your veins, tinging your soul with malign power. Perhaps your ancestor was subject to an ancient hereditary curse passed onto all of their offspring; or perhaps they themselves were the one doling them out, blackening their heart with malignant power. Whatever the cause, this power is now yours to command, for better and for worse.

This malignant magic very rarely leaves one untouched. You can pick from or roll on the Eldritch Marks table to determine how this power has left its mark on you, or come up with an appropriate effect yourself.

Eldritch Marks
d6 Mark
1 When you make a verbal threat towards someone, your voice noticeably echoes no matter the surroundings.
2 You have an unhealing scar that visibly glows when you cast any of your sorcerer spells.
3 One of your eyes is blinded or destroyed — but you swear you can still occasionally see fleeting and esoteric visions through it.
4 You feel slightly dizzy and out of breath when standing in holy or consecrated ground.
5 You constantly hear whispering voices that incite you to acts of malice and disproportionate vengeance. Whether or not you listen is up to you.
6 Any curse word uttered by you will sometimes be accompanied by a peal of thunder or a raven's cry, whether you want it or not.

1.name: Bonus Spell List
description: Your link to the occult allows you to learn spells normally associated with the warlock class. When your Sorcery feature lets you learn a cantrip or a spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose the new spell from the Occult spell list or the Arcane spell list. You must otherwise obey all the restrictions for selecting the spell.

1.name: Blood Hex
description: Starting at 1st level, you can beckon the wicked magic within your blood to wrap around others. The intensity of this magic is represented by your Curse Die, which starts as a d4. Your Curse Die increases in size when you reach certain levels in this class: at 6th level (d6), 10th level (d8), 14th level (d10) and 18th level (d12).
As a bonus action, you can curse a creature you can see within 60 feet. While a creature is cursed in this way, it suffers from the following effects:

• Whenever the cursed creature makes an ability check, roll your Curse Die and subtract the result from the roll.
  • Whenever the cursed creature succeeds on an attack roll against you or fails a saving throw against a spell you cast, it takes necrotic damage equal to a roll of your Curse Die.

The duration of your Blood Hex is 1 minute. It increases when you reach certain levels in this class; to 1 hour at 6th level, 24 hours at 10th level, 7 days at 14th level, and 30 days at 18th level. It ends early if you die, if you choose to end it (no action required), if you curse another creature with it, or if remove curse or similar magic is cast on the target.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest, unless you expend 2 sorcery points to use it again.

6.name: Accursed Sorcery
description: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell, you can treat the target of your Blood Hex as a valid target for the spell regardless of range, obstructions or line of sight, so long as it's within 120 feet of you and you are aware of its location.

6.name: Resilient Curse
description: Also at 6th level, Your curses coil tightly around their targets. If a remove curse spell or similar effect attempts to end one of your curses (such as your Blood Hex), you become aware of this, and you can roll your Curse Die. If the result is higher than the level of the counteracting effect, it fails, and your curse can't be removed by that effect for the next 24 hours.
If the counteracting effect isn't a spell, treat its level as equal to the proficiency bonus of its user.

14.name: Soul Hex
description: Starting at 14th level, your curse now binds itself completely to your target's soul. The damage dealt by your Blood Hex increases to two rolls of your Curse Die and ignores damage resistances.
Additionally, when you curse a creature with your Blood Hex, you can enhance the curse in one of the following ways:

subFeatures.name: Hex of Insight
description: The cursed creature's mind is torn open for you to scrutinize. You know the target's surface thoughts (as per detect thoughts) at all times, and you can cast modify memory on it at will without expending a spell slot.

subFeatures.name: Hex of Nightmares
description: The cursed creature is constantly kept awake and on edge by illusory phenomena. The target can't take short rests, and you can cast dream on it at will without expending a spell slot.

subFeatures.name: Hex of Revealing
description: The cursed creature's soul is marked, never to escape from your sight. You can see the true form of the target as if seeing through truesight, and you can cast scrying on it at will without expending a spell slot.

18.name: One Thousand Needles
description: At 18th level, when your Blood Hex ends on a creature, you can use your reaction to violently release the curse's magic and rend the target's soul asunder. The target must make a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it takes 6d12 necrotic damage and is paralyzed until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't paralyzed.
If you kill a creature with this damage, its soul is torn apart and can't be brought back to life by any means short of the wish spell, and you regain your use of this feature.
Otherwise, once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

subclasses.name: Eldritch Soul

description: Your innate magic manifests in elemental surges. You are your element, and your element is you.

1.name: Heart of the Elements
description: At 1st level, whenever you start casting a spell of 1st level or higher that deals damage of your elemental type, elemental magic erupts from you. This eruption causes creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you to take damage of your elemental type equal to half your sorcerer level (minimum of 1).

6.name: Elements in the Veins
description: At 6th level, you gain resistance to your elemental type of damage. In addition, spells you cast ignore resistance to your elemental type of damage.
You gain resistance to acid damage and have advantage on saving throws against being broken.
You gain resistance to cold damage and have advantage on saving throws against being hobbled.
You gain resistance to fire damage and have advantage on saving throws against being burning.
You gain resistance to lightning damage and have advantage on saving throws against being paralyzed.
You gain resistance to poison damage and have advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.
You gain resistance to thunder damage and have advantage on saving throws against being deafened or silenced.

14.name: Elemental Soul's Fury
description: Starting at 14th level, when you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal damage of your elemental type to the attacker. The damage equals your sorcerer level, and ignores resistance to your elemental type of damage.

18.name: Elemental Body
description: At 18th level, you gain immunity to your elemental type of damage. In addition, any spell or effect you create ignores resistance to your elemental type of damage and treats immunity to your elemental type of damage as resistance to your elemental type of damage.
You gain immunity to acid damage and you can't be broken.
You gain immunity to cold damage and you can't be hobbled.
You gain immunity to fire damage and you can't be burning.
You gain immunity to lightning damage and you can't be paralyzed.
You gain immunity to poison damage and you can't be poisoned.
You gain immunity to thunder damage and you can't be deafened or silenced.

subclasses.name: Elemental Soul

description: Your power comes from an ancestor that once called the heavens their home. For some reason however, they fell from grace and became a fallen celestial. Their actions since have led to your birth and as you became aware of your magical talent you noticed that there was a touch of the divine in it; as well as a touch of the damned.

1.name: Power of Duality
description: Also starting at 1st level, you know the Chill Touch or Pacify cantrip, which is considered an arcane spell for you and does not count against the number of cantrips you know.

1.name: Dual Halo
description: At 1st level, you can use a bonus action to summon a dark and divine halo to floats above your head for 1 minute. It gives you the following benefits:

• You gain resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.
  • You can use a bonus action to allow a creature you can see to make a saving throw against an affect that allows a saving throw to be made to end the effects.
  • You can use a bonus action to cause a creature that can see you to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell DC. Unless they succeed, they are frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Once a creature suffers this effect, it has advantage on this saving throw for the next 24 hours.
Once you summon your dual halo you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

6.name: Purify / Putrefy
description: At 6th level, you can use an action and expend 3 sorcery points in order to cast the Consecration or Desecration spell.

In addition, allied creatures that receive healing while within 30 feet of you regain additional hit points equal to half your sorcerer level. Hostile creatures that receive healing in the same range reduce the amount of hit points they regain by the same value.

14.name: Dark Wings
description: Starting at 14th level, you gain a pair of dark feathery wings which give you a flying speed of 30 feet.

18.name: Divine Menace
description: At 18th level, when you use your Dual Halo feature, your flying speed is increased by an additional 30 feet and creatures that are frightened of you within 60 feet must spend their action to drop their weapons and their movement to move as far away from you as possible.

subclasses.name: Fallen Celestial

description: Your magic is influenced by the changeable nature of the feywilds, and your powers shift with the seasons themselves.

1.name: One With Nature
description: Starting at 1st level, you gain proficiency in the Nature skill and you learn the Druidcraft cantrip.

1.name: Seasonal Attunement
description: You can change the season you are attuned to when you finish a long rest.

6.name: Ecological Embodiment
description: At 6th level, your chosen season grants the following benefits:

traits.name: Autumnal Winds
description: When you cast Gust, the distance you can push a creature increases up to 5 x your proficiency bonus feet. A target knocked prone or pushed by your Arcane spells takes bludgeoning damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

traits.name: Vernal Healing
description: When you cast a seasonal spell of 1st-level or higher, you regain hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. You can spend 2 sorcery points to also grant this same benefit to one other creature within 30 feet of you.

traits.name: Fiery Wrath
description: When you cast Produce Flame, you can hurl it up to 60 feet, rather than 30, and you can conjure flames in both hands. If you do, a target takes extra fire damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier when you hit with your attack.

traits.name: Icy Oppression
description: Whenever a creature within 30 feet of you moves at least 10 feet with their movement, you can spend 2 sorcery points as a reaction to force it to make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or fall prone.

14.name: Season's Zenith
description: At 14th level your seasonal magic flares with the intensity of the peak of your season.

traits.name: Autumnal Resilience
description: Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can either grant twice your sorcerer level + your spellcasting ability modifier amount of temporary hit points, divided as you choose among creatures that you can see within 30 feet of you. Affected creatures are also cured of any diseases or poisons affecting it.

traits.name: Vernal Restoration
description: Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you can either grant twice your sorcerer level + your spellcasting ability modifier amount of temporary hit points, divided as you choose among creatures that you can see within 30 feet of you. Affected creatures are also cured of any diseases or poisons affecting it.

traits.name: Flames of the Solstice
description: Whenever you or a creature within 30 feet of you would take fire damage, you can use your reaction grant resistance to that creature against the damage until the end of your next turn. In addition, once on each of your turns when you make an attack or cast a spell that deals fire damage, you can add your spellcasting ability modifier to one damage roll of that attack or spell.

traits.name: Ice of the Night
description: Whenever you or a creature within 30 feet of you would take cold damage, you can use your reaction grant resistance to that creature against the damage until the end of your next turn. In addition, once on each of your turns when you make an attack or cast a spell that deals cold damage, you can add your spellcasting ability modifier to one damage roll of that attack or spell.

18.name: Avatar of the Seasons
description: Starting at 18th level, you can spend 7 sorcery points as a bonus action to magically transform. For 1 minute, you gain the benefits of each season's Ecological Embodiment feature, and you can cast 1st or 2nd-level spell from any season's spell list at its lowest level without expending a spell slot. For the duration, you also gain a flying speed of 60 feet, but you fall if you end your turn in the air and nothing else is holding you aloft.

subclasses.name: Fey Lineage

description: The giants once dwelled in a fabled realm known as Ostoria, a paradise for their folk that reflected their mastery of the mortal realm. In time, Ostoria fell, and the giants were scattered and broken. During that mythic era, the giants granted a few chosen individuals among the small folk a shard of their great power. These favored people were caught in the same tragedy that sundered Ostoria. Since that time, they have spread across the many worlds of the multiverse. Now and again, one of their descendants manifests the gifts imparted by the giants, granting them sorcerous magic that allows them to command the elements and gain the might of a giant.

1.name: Jotun Resilience
description: The resilience of giants flows through your body. At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class.
In addition, you learn to speak, read, and write Jiganti.

6.name: Soul of Lost Ostoria
description: Starting at 6th level, you gain a benefit whenever you cast one of the spells granted by your Jotun Magic Feature.

traits.name: Uvar Lightning
description: Immediately after you cast any of your Jotun Magic spells, up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you take lightning damage equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1).

traits.name: Skye Teleportation
description: Immediately after you cast any of your Jotun Magic spells, you can magically teleport as a bonus action. You teleport to an unoccupied space you can see that is no farther away than a number of feet equal to 10 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

traits.name: Ild Fury
description: You gain a bonus to the damage rolls of your Jotun Magic spells. The bonus equals your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of +1).

traits.name: Ise Courage
description: Immediately after you cast any of your Jotun Magic spells, you gain temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1). If the spell is Armor of Agathys, you instead increase its temporary hit points by an amount equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1).

traits.name: Stein Resilience
description: Immediately after you cast any of your Jotun Magic spells, you gain a bonus to AC equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of +1) until the end of your next turn.

traits.name: Haug Brawn
description: Immediately after you cast any of your Jotun Magic spells, you can target up to two creatures within 5 feet of you that you can see. Each target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC or be pushed a number of feet away from you equal to 5 + your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of +1). A target can choose to fail this save.

14.name: Rage of Fallen Ostoria
description: Starting at 14th level, you gain the ability to channel the souls of your ancestors into your physical form. When you start casting an arcane spell on your turn and expend spell points, you can increase your size by one category - from Medium to Large, for example. This increase lasts for 1 minute. It ends early if you die or are incapacitated. Until it ends, you gain the following benefits:

• Your current hit points and your hit point maximum both increase by 1 per sorcerer level.
  • Your reach increases by 5 feet.
  • Your walking speed increases by 5 feet.
  • You have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
  • You gain a bonus to the damage rolls of your melee weapon attacks; the bonus equals your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of +1).
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

18.name: Blessing of the All Father
description: At 18th level, your Constitution score increases by 2, up to a maximum of 22.

In addition, you can now use Rage of Fallen Ostoria twice between rests, but no more than once on a turn. If you use that feature while under its effects, its increases to your size, hit points, reach, and walking speed are cumulative.

subclasses.name: Giant Soul

description: Unlike many other sorcerers, the circumstances of your birth were mundane and you have no arcane inheritance passed down from strange ancestors. Instead, you gained your sorcerous powers after you managed to survive an experience that left you on the brink of death. Since that experience you've had a preternatural sense for danger and a ghostly companion that either can't or won't leave you alone. Some Haunted, as sorcerers who share your origin are called, develop cordial relationships with their phantom, while others find their spectral companion to be a relentless nuisance.

1.name: Phantom Companion
description: At 1st level, you learn the Find Familiar spell and can cast it as a ritual. The spell doesn't count against your number of spells known.
When you cast the spell, you can only choose the form of a specter, which becomes your phantom companion. Instead of a creature type of your choice, this familiar's creature type is undead.

As an action, you can command your phantom companion to turn invisible until it attacks or you cast a spell through it. While invisible, it leaves no physical evidence of its passage, so it can be tracked only by magic. Any equipment or objects it is holding remains visible.
Additionally, at 3rd level, when you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make its Life Drain attack with its reaction.

1.name: Sixth Sense
description: Starting at 1st level, when you make a Dexterity ability check to determine initiative, you gain a bonus to the roll equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

6.name: Strength of Spirit
description: At 6th level, your bond to the specter summoned by your Phantom Companion feature empowers it further. You gain the following benefits:

• Your specter's maximum hit points increase by four times your level in this class.
  • Your specter can deliver spells of any range, not just touch. Apart from this change, it follows all the normal rules of casting a spell through your familiar.
  • When you use your action to cast a spell, you can use a bonus action on the same turn to command your specter to use its Life Drain attack against a creature within range of your choice.

6.name: Deathly Pallor
description: Also at 6th level, you gain resistance to necrotic damage. In addition, when you cast a spell that deals damage, you can choose to change the damage type dealt to necrotic.

14.name: Phantom Possession
description: At 14th level, as an action you can direct your phantom companion to attempt to possess and enter a humanoid of your choice within 5 feet of your phantom. Creatures immune to the charmed condition are immune to this feature. When you do, the creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC or be possessed by your phantom for 1 minute. During this time your phantom cannot be affected by spells or abilities, take actions, or interact with in any way.

While the target is possessed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are within 100 feet. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability, taking the Dodge action if it has not used its action already.

Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Charisma saving throw against the possession. If the saving throw succeeds, the possession ends and your phantom companion reappears in the closest unoccupied space.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a short rest.

18.name: Become Death
description: At 18th level, you can transmute your physical form into a spectral one when you near death. When you take damage that would reduce you to 0 hit points, you drop to 1 hit point instead and gain temporary hit points equal to half your maximum hit points. At the start of each of your turns, you lose 5 temporary hit points and all creatures of your choice within 30 feet take 5 necrotic damage. While you have any temporary hit points granted from this feature, you have resistance to all damage, a fly speed of 30 feet, and can move through creatures and objects provided you end your movement in an unoccupied space.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

subclasses.name: Haunted

description: Somewhere in your bloodline, one of your ancestors made a pact with a powerful spirit of flame and predation. This creature may be an elemental, fiend, fey, or something else primal and otherworldly honored with ritualistic immolation and sacrifices of meat and metal.
With smoke and cinders pouring from your hands with each spell you cast and a layer of ash gradually creeping over your body, you are the incarnation of a smoldering ember thrown upon a dry forest.

1.name: Born of Ember
description: At 1st level, you can speak, read, and write Infernal.

Additionally, whenever you are below half your hit point maximum, a thin layer of ash and char engulfs your skin and embers erupt from your hands. While you have this layer, you can cast the Produce Flame cantrip as a bonus action.

6.name: Burning Fury
description: Starting at 6th level, when you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with the Produce Flame cantrip, the burning fury empowering your attack surges through the creature, turning its vital organs to ash and granting you temporary hit points equal to twice your spellcasting ability modifier.

Additionally, you can spend 2 sorcery points during your turn when you are below half your hit point maximum to cause the ash upon your skin to harden. Until the start of your next turn, you have resistance to fire and necrotic damage and your AC is 17 if it was lower.
At 14th level, you gain immunity instead of resistance.

14.name: Wraith of Cinders
description: At 14th level, your spark has grown to a flame, burning black with dark power. Any time you would inflict fire damage, you can choose to inflict necrotic damage instead, and vice versa.

Additionally, your ashen form allows you to move with unnatural ease, disintegrating and reforming with each step you take. You ignore difficult terrain, and you can move through any space at least 6 inches wide without squeezing.

18.name: The Devil's Bargain
description: At 18th level, your power over the ancient and primal magics of flame and darkness is without peer.

As an action, you can spend 7 sorcery points to launch yourself skyward in a pillar of fire and smoke before crashing down at a location that you can see within 60 feet of your point of origin, unleashing a hellish blast of fire and cursed power at a creature within 5 feet of you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Arcane spell save DC, taking 6d10 fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

If the target is slain by this attack, it is consumed instantly by flame, and the ashes coalesce into a hell hound. The hell hound obeys your orders without question and acts during your turn. You can't have more than two hell hounds at a time from this feature. Creation of a third hell hound destroys the oldest one still alive. Each hell hound remains in your service until slain or until the third dawn after it was summoned, at which point it disintegrates into ash.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

subclasses.name: Hellspawn

description: There is power in king's blood. Your innate magic comes from your royal ancestry. Whether you are a far flung cousin of a great house, the child of a deposed prince, a secret bastard denied legitimacy, or the rightful heir to a kingdom, your bloodline is that of kings and emperors. You might be unaware of your lineage and of the source of your power, or perhaps you have always known yourself to be the true inheritor of a throne now held by usurpers.

1.name: Ancestral Homeland
description: Starting at 1st level, you gain proficiency in your choice of Intimidation, Performance, Persuasion, or Society. You also learn a language of your choice and gain proficiency with a tool of your choice. You have advantage on Intelligence (History) checks to recall information about culture, people, and politics.

1.name: Commanding Voice
description: Also at 1st level, your bloodline has granted you a voice fit for a ruler, one that makes your enemies tremble and puts fire into the hearts of your allies. Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that has verbal components, you can grant temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier to a friendly creature other than yourself within 30 feet of you, which last for 1 minute.

6.name: Majestic Presence
description: Starting 6th level, you gain an aura of majesty that steels the hearts and minds of those who follow you. When you or a friendly creature within 30 feet of you makes a Charisma or Wisdom saving throw, you can use your reaction to grant them advantage on the saving throw before the results of the roll is revealed.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your spellcasting ability modifier, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

6.name: Royal Decree
description: Also at 6th level, when you cast a spell with verbal components, you can spend 2 sorcery points to imbue your voice with magic. You can perform the verbal components regardless of any obstruction to your ability to speak, such physical restraints or the Silence spell. If the spell involves speaking to a creature, that creature being deafened or not sharing a language with you does not prevent the creature from hearing and understanding you.

14.name: Bend the Knee
description: Beginning at 14th level, when a creature fails the initial saving throw imposed by one of your spells, you can choose for them to also become frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

18.name: Cognomen
description: At 18th level, you adopt a title befit a legendary monarch, and gain permanent benefits associated with that title. Choose one of the following benefits:
Increase one ability score of your choice by 2. Your maximum for that score is now 22.
You learn the Sanctuary and Protection from Evil and Good spells, which count as arcane spells for you. You can cast them at will, without expending sorcery points.
You are immune to being frightened and you have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are frightened of you.
Choose three of your skill proficiencies. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks made with them.

subclasses.name: Imperial Bloodline

description: Often born during times of great war and strife, Ironmonger Sorcerers have an affinity for all things forged for use in war. They thrive in the midst of battle, wielding potent war magic on the front lines. Ironmongers are formidable foes, and are sought after by captains and conquerers for their ability to turn the tide of any battle, no matter how hopeless.

1.name: Ancient Knowledge
description: At 1st level, the arcane power within your soul grants you an affinity with the armaments of war. You gain proficiency with all light and medium armor, shields, and all simple and martial weapons.

1.name: Blade of Strife
description: Also at 1st level, you can conjure up the signature weapon of an Ironmonger, the Blade of Strife. As a bonus action, you conjure this mystical Blade at a point you can see within 60 feet. It lasts for 1 minute or until you use this feature again.

When you conjure the Blade, you can make a melee spell attack against one creature within 10 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 magical slashing damage. As a bonus action, you can move the Blade up to 30 feet and repeat the attack.

You can conjure this Blade a number of times equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all of your expended uses when you finish a long rest. You can only have one Blade at a time, and conjuring a second causes the first Blade to dispel. Finally, if you have no uses of this feature remaining, you can spend 3 Sorcery Points to use it again.

6.name: Extra Attack
description: Starting at 6th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, when you take the Attack action on your turn.
Moreover, you can cast one of your cantrips in place of one of those attacks.
Finally, when your Blade of Strife is within 10 feet of you, you can make attacks with it as part of your Attack action.

6.name: Iron Smite
description: Also starting at 6th level, once per turn when you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee weapon or Blade of Strife attack you can force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save it falls prone.

14.name: Dancing Blade
description: At 14th level, when a creature within 10 feet of your Blade of Strife is hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to add your spellcasting ability modifier to the target's Armor Class against that attack.
Also, your Blade of Strife now deals 2d8 damage on hit.

18.name: Storm of Blades
description: At 18th level, you have become a god of warfare and lay waste to your foes. As an action on your turn, you can destroy your Blade of Strife in a storm of arcane iron shards, forcing two creatures of your choice within 30 feet of the Blade to make a Dexterity saving throw. Targets take 6d8 magical slashing damage on a failed save, and half as much damage on a successful save.
When you use this action, you can spend Sorcery Points to target additional creatures, targeting one additional creature of your choice within 30 feet per Sorcery Point you spend.

subclasses.name: Ironmonger

description: On many worlds, the moon is a revered celestial body with magical properties. On Krynn, the gods of magic are associated with the world's three moons. On the world of Toril, the god Sel'ne uses the light of the moon to battle darkness. On Eberron, scholars of the Draconic Prophecy decipher ancient secrets from the waxing and waning of that world's twelve moons.

You, or someone from your lineage, has been exposed to the concentrated magic of the moon (or moons) of your world, imbuing you with lunar magic. Perhaps your ancestor was involved in a druidic ritual involving an eclipse, or maybe a mystical fragment of a moon crashed near you. However you came to have your magic, your connection to the moon is obvious when you cast Arcane spells. Consult the Manifestations of Lunar Magic table, then choose or randomly determine how your connection to the moon manifests while you cast your Arcane spells.

Manifestations of Lunar Magic
d4 Manifestation
1 You glow with faint light that matches the color of a moon from your world.
2 Your pupils shift in shape, matching the current phase of a moon from your world.
3 Spectral manifestations of the moon (or moons) of your world orbit you.
4 Your shadow is limned in faint light, as if it were a lunar body during a solar eclipse.

1.name: Moon Fire
description: Starting at 1st level, you can call down the radiant light of the moon on command. You learn the Sacred Flame spell, which doesn't count against the number of sorcerer cantrips you know. When you cast the spell, you can target one creature as normal or target two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other.

6.name: Lunar Boons
description: Starting at 6th level, lunar phases influence your metamagic. Each lunar phase is associated with spells of the following schools of magic.

Whenever you use Metamagic on a spell from the Lunar Spells table or a spell of a school of magic associated with the lunar phase you are in, you can reduce the sorcery points spent by 1 (minimum 0). You can reduce the sorcery points spent for your Metamagic a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
You can use Lunar Boons on divination and transmutation spells.
You can use Lunar Boons on abjuration and restoration spells.
You can use Lunar Boons on evocation and necromancy spells.

6.name: Waxing and Waning
description: Starting at 6th level, you gain greater control over the phases of your lunar magic. As a bonus action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change your lunar phase for a different one.

14.name: Lunar Empowerment
description: Starting at 14th level, the power of a lunar phase saturates your being. Whenever you choose a lunar phase to affect your magic, you also gain the following benefit associated with that phase:
You have resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.

You shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. In addition, you and creatures of your choice have advantage on saving throws while within the bright light you shed.
You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. In addition, while you are in dim light or darkness, attack rolls have disadvantage against you.

18.name: Lunar Phenomenon
description: At 18th level, your lunar phase magic bursts. As a bonus action, you can tap into a special power of the lunar phase you are currently in. Alternatively, as part of the bonus action you take to change your lunar phase using your Waxing and Waning feature, you can immediately use the power of the lunar phase you are entering.
Once you use a phase's bonus action, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you spend 7 sorcery points to use it again.

You slip through light and darkness. You can magically teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of yourself. In addition, you also gain resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.

You radiate intense moonlight for a moment. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or be blinded until the end of its next turn. In addition, one creature of your choice in that area regains 3d8 hit points.

You momentarily emanate an oppressive gloom. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC or take 3d10 necrotic damage and have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. In addition, you become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you make an attack or cast a spell.

subclasses.name: Lunar Magic

description: Music courses through your blood, and your heart sings its own song. Your ancestor could have been a legendary bard or a copper dragon. Whatever the cause, your inner song guides you forwards, and keeps you oriented through the darkest of times.

1.name: Bonus Spell List
description: Your link to music allows you to learn spells normally associated with the bard class. When your Sorcery feature lets you learn a cantrip or a spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose the new spell from the Melodic spell list or the Arcane spell list. You must otherwise obey all the restrictions for selecting the spell.

1.name: Musical Inspiration
description: Starting at 1st level, your music can give inspiration to others.  If a creature within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw or misses with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to roll 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
In addition, you gain proficiency with one instrument of your choice, unless you expend 2 sorcery points to use it again.

6.name: Potent Chord
description: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that restores hit points or deals psychic or thunder damage, you can add your spellcasting ability modifier to the hit points restored or damage dealt by the spell.

6.name: Song's Guidance
description: Also at 6th level, your inner song guides you through any situation and makes it easier to be true to yourself.  You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, dominated, or frightened.

14.name: Enhanced Inspiration
description: At 14th level, when you use your Musical Inspiration feature, the target hears your song and can immediately make a saving throw against an effect causing them to be charmed, dominated, or frightened.  If they succeed on their saving throw, the creature causing the effect cannot charm, dominate, or frighten the target for 1 hour.

18.name: Spirit of Music
description: At 18th level, your song can be heard by all, and it flows through every action.  When you use your Musical Inspiration feature, you can cause the target to be filled with your song for the next minute.
While a target hears your song, they gain the following benefits:

• They have advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
  • They cannot be charmed, dominated, or frightened. If they are under any of these effects when you use this feature, the effects end immediately.
  • Whenever they cast a spell, it takes effect as if cast at one level higher.
  • Whenever they use an exploit, they add 2d4 to any dice rolled as part of the exploit.
You can use this feature once, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

subclasses.name: Musical Soul

description: Your power draws from the immortal flame that fuels the legendary phoenix. You or your ancestors perhaps rendered a phoenix a great service, or you were born in its presence. Whatever the cause, a shard of the phoenix's power dwells within you. That power is a mixed blessing. Like the mythical creature, you can invoke fiery energy and gain the ability to cheat death itself. This power comes at a cost. The fire within you seethes, demanding to be unleashed. You sometimes find yourself absentmindedly feeding fires. You can't bear to allow a fire to sputter out. You feel most comfortable while holding a lit torch or sitting in front of a campfire.

1.name: The Spark
description: When you choose this Origin at 1st level, you have a spark within that burns more brightly when you use your magic. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that deals fire or radiant damage, the spark ignites and begins to blaze.

Upon casting the spell, you regain hit points equal to the level of the spell slot you expended. At the start of subsequent turns, you regain that amount minus 1 hit point per turn elapsed until it would restore 0 hit points, at which point the spark becomes dormant. If you are reduced to 0 hit points, the spark immediately goes dormant.

If you cast a spell that sets the spark ablaze while it is already ablaze, you regain hit points equal to the level of the spell you just cast and you can reset the amount of hit points the spark restores to the level of that spell if it is higher than what the spark would otherwise restore at the start of your next turn.

6.name: Flames Ablaze
description: Starting at 6th level, the spark within you strengthens, and you draw more deeply from its power. While the spark within you is ablaze, you gain the following benefits:

• You can add your spellcasting ability modifier to one damage roll of spells that deal fire or radiant damage.
  • As a reaction to taking fire or radiant damage, you can gain resistance to that instance of damage, and increase the level of your spark by 1.

14.name: In Flames Reborn
description: Starting at 14th level, when you ignite the spark within or while it is ablaze you can use a bonus action and expend 3 sorcery points to make the fire surge forth from you. Flames consumes your physical body leaving you as a winged shape of fire until the start of your next turn. You can extend the duration of this form for by expending an additional 3 sorcery points each round. In this form, you gain the effect of the Form of Fire spell with following additional benefits:

• You have a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover.
  • You become immune to the poisoned condition and to disease.
  • The amount of hit points you regain from your Spark feature is doubled, however it still lasts for the same number of rounds.
  • Your Spark does not go dormant if you reach 0 hit points.
  • When you return to your normal form, you gain one level of exhaustion.

18.name: Phoenix Unleashed
description: Starting at 18th level, as an action, you can take the form of a phoenix for a number of rounds equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. Your game statistics are replaced by the statistics of the phoenix, but you retain your alignment, personality, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. You do not gain its Legendary Actions or Legendary Resistances. You can't cast spells, speak, nor take any action that requires hands. The equipment you wear merges into your new form and has no effect until you leave the form.

When the duration ends or you are reduced to zero hit points, the phoenix's Fiery Death and Rebirth feature is triggered, leaving behind your normal form instead of an egg. If you revert as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to your normal form.
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.

subclasses.name: Phoenix Spark

description: You are a creature of shadow, for your innate magic comes from the Shadowfell itself. You might trace your lineage to an entity from that place, or perhaps you were exposed to its fell energy and transformed by it.

The power of shadow magic casts a strange pall over your physical presence. The spark of life that sustains you is muffled, as if it struggles to remain viable against the dark energy that imbues your soul.  At your option, you can pick from or roll on the Shadow Sorcerer Quirks table to create a quirk for your character.

d6 Quirk
1 You are always icy cold to the touch.
2 When you are asleep, you don't appear to breathe (though you must still breathe to survive).
3 You barely bleed, even when badly injured.
4 Your heart beats once per minute. This event sometimes surprises you.
5 You have trouble remembering that living creatures and corpses should be treated differently.
6 You blinked. Once. Last week.

1.name: Eyes of the Dark
description: From 1st level, you have darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

When you reach 3rd level in this class, you learn the Darkness spell, which doesn't count against your number of Arcane spells known. In addition, you can cast it by spending 2 sorcery points, and you can see through the darkness created by the spell.

1.name: Strength of the Grave
description: Starting at 1st level, your existence in a twilight state between life and death makes you difficult to defeat. When damage reduces you to 0 hit points, you can make a Charisma saving throw (DC 5 + the damage taken). On a success, you instead drop to 1 hit point. You can't use this feature if you are reduced to 0 hit points by radiant damage or by a critical hit.
After the saving throw succeeds, you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest.

6.name: Hound of Ill Omen
description: At 6th level, you gain the ability to call forth a howling creature of darkness to harass your foes. As a bonus action, you can spend 5 sorcery points to summon a hound of ill omen to target one creature you can see within 120 feet of you. The hound uses the dire wolf's statistics, with the following changes:

• The hound is size Medium, not Large, and it counts as an undead, not a beast.
  • It appears with a number of temporary hit points equal to half your sorcerer level.
  • It can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. The hound takes 5 force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
  • At the start of its turn, the hound automatically knows its target's location. If the target was hidden, it is no longer hidden from the hound.

The hound appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet of the target. Roll initiative for the hound. On its turn, it can move only toward its target by the most direct route, and it can use its action only to attack its target. The hound can make opportunity attacks, but only against its target. Additionally, while the hound is within 5 feet of the target, the target has disadvantage on saving throws against any spell you cast. The hound disappears if it is reduced to 0 hit points, if its target is reduced to 0 hit points, or after 5 minutes.

14.name: Shadow Walk
description: At 14th level, you gain the ability to step from one shadow into another. When you are in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action, you can teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

18.name: Umbral Form
description: Starting at 18th level, you can spend 6 sorcery points as a bonus action to transform yourself into a shadowy form. In this form, you have resistance to all damage except force and radiant damage, and you can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. You take 5 force damage if you end your turn inside an object.
You remain in this form for 1 minute. It ends early if you are incapacitated, if you die, or if you dismiss it as a bonus action.

subclasses.name: Shadow Magic

description: Your blood comes from a steadfast lineage, touched by the elemental forces of the earth itself. Be it the blood of ancient dwarves first formed from stone or from a dao lineage, your heart beats more steadily than others.

Blessed with natural resilience and command over the ground you stand on, most Stoneheart sorcerers are solid and deliberate in both action and thought, slow to anger and often given to taking a long term point of view. However, if stirred to action, they are as stout and unwavering as rock.

1.name: Bonus Proficiencies
description: At 1st level, you gain proficiency with simple and martial weapons.

1.name: Heart of Stone
description: When you choose this origin at 1st level, you can draw upon the earthen magic within you harden your physical form for a limited time. Starting at 1st level, you can use a bonus action to take on an elemental form, your physical form becomes covered in rock and stone, and you gain the following benefits:

• If you are not wearing armor, you armor class is equal to 13 + your Constitution modifier.
  • When you cast a spell, you can use your Strength modifier in place of your spellcasting ability modifier.
  • When you make a weapon attack, you can use your spellcasting ability modifier in place of your Strength modifier.

This transformation lasts for one minute, or until you end it as a bonus action or fall unconscious. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

6.name: Stone Aegis
description: Starting at 6th level, as a bonus action, you can expend 3 sorcery points to create a visible aura of protection on yourself or another allied creature you can see within 60 feet on you. The shield lasts for 1 minute, until you use it again, or until you are incapacitated.

Once per turn, when the creature takes bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage, the aegis absorbs some of the damage from the attack and empowers you with it. The damage the protected creature takes is reduced by 1d6, and you store that power in yourself.

Your next damage roll that deals bludgeoning, piercing or slashing damage is bolstered by the power you stored, and you add your stored number of d6s to the roll. You can store a maximum of two hits (2d6 total), and once the maximum is reached you must expend the stored power before the aegis can absorb more damage.
The maximum number of hits you can reduce the damage of and store energy from before expending it increases to three (3d6) at 11th level, and to four at 17th level (4d6).

6.name: Extra Attack
description: Starting at 6th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action.
Moreover, you can cast one of your cantrips in place of one of those attacks.

14.name: Stonewalk
description: Starting at 14th level, you gain a borrowing speed of 15 feet, allowing you to travel through the earth. You can pass through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone, leaving no hole behind you. If you would end your turn inside of earth or stone, you are pushed back to where you entered the earth or stone's surface.

18.name: Unity of Stone
description: Starting at 18th level, whenever you transform with your Heart of Stone feature, you gain temporary hit points equal to your sorcerer level. The temporary hit points disappear when your transformation ends.

Additionally, your Stone's Aegis no longer requires sorcery points to use, and when you use it to protect someone other than yourself, you can create another aegis on yourself as part of the same bonus action. The maximum number of hits these shields can store are counted together as part of the same total.

subclasses.name: Stoneheart

description: Your innate magic comes from the power of elemental air. Many with this power can trace their magic back to a near-death experience caused by the Great Rain, but perhaps you were born during a howling gale so powerful that folk still tell stories of it, or your lineage might include the influence of potent air creatures such as vaati or djinn. Whatever the case, the magic of the storm permeates your being.

Storm sorcerers are invaluable members of a ship's crew. Their magic allows them to exert control over wind and weather in their immediate area. Their abilities also prove useful in repelling attacks by sahuagin, pirates, and other waterborne threats.

1.name: Wind Speaker
description: Starting at 1st level, the arcane magic you command is infused with elemental air. You can speak, read, and write Primordial. Knowing this language allows you to understand and be understood by those who speak its dialects: Aquan, Auran, Ignan, and Terran.

1.name: Tempestuous Magic
description: Starting at 1st level, you can use a bonus action on your turn to cause whirling gusts of elemental air to briefly surround you, immediately before or after you cast a spell of 1st level or higher. Doing so allows you to fly up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

6.name: Heart of the Storm
description: At 6th level, you gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage. In addition, whenever you start casting a spell that deals lightning or thunder damage, stormy magic erupts from you. This eruption causes creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you to take lightning or thunder damage (choose each time this ability activates) equal to half your sorcerer level.

6.name: Storm Guide
description: At 6th level, you gain the ability to subtly control the weather around you.
If it is raining, you can use an action to cause the rain to stop falling in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you. You can end this effect as a bonus action.

If it is windy, you can use a bonus action each round to choose the direction that the wind blows in a 100-foot-radius sphere centered on you. The wind blows in that direction until the end of your next turn. This feature doesn't alter the speed of the wind.

14.name: Storm's Fury
description: Starting at 14th level, when you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to deal lightning damage to the attacker. The damage equals your sorcerer level. The attacker must also make a Strength saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the attacker is pushed in a straight line up to 20 feet away from you.

18.name: Wind Soul
description: At 18th level, you gain immunity to lightning and thunder damage.

You also gain a magical flying speed of 60 feet. As an action, you can reduce your flying speed to 30 feet for 1 hour and choose a number of creatures within 30 feet of you equal to 3 + your spellcasting ability modifier. The chosen creatures gain a magical flying speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. Once you reduce your flying speed in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

subclasses.name: Storm Sorcery

description: A lineage tethered to the deepest of depths, you trace your powers back to the heartbeat of the ocean. Perhaps your ancestor was born below the waves and ascended in search of the world above, or perhaps they were the survivor of a shipwreck, having struck a bargain with one of the great gods below the disappearing light. Perhaps even you, yourself, were born amidst the aftermath of a devastating tsunami, your feet treading water long before they touched the ground.

Tideborn feel the push and pull of the ocean much akin to their own heartbeat. They understand the incessant, relentless rhythm of their ancestry unlike any other. They may venture inland in search of fame, glory, or an escape from their coastal calling, but conscious or not, they will eventually respond to the pull of a homebound tide.

1.name: Born of Water
description: When you choose this origin at 1st level, your natural affinity for the sea grants you several gifts. You gain the ability to breathe underwater, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

1.name: Ebb And Flow
description: Starting at 1st level, your body moves in time with the rhythm of the tides, allowing you to imbue your magic with powerful momentum. Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that successfully affected a creature other than yourself, you gain advantage on your next attack roll made against a different creature. This advantage lasts until the end of your next turn, and if you hit with this attack against a Large or smaller creature, you can choose to knock it up to 10 feet away from you. This distance increases by 5 feet at your 6th and 11th level in this class.

6.name: Cascading Torrent
description: Starting at 6th level, your attunement with the tide improves and your command over its unrelenting force increases. Whenever you forcibly move a creature, that creature takes 1d8 cold damage for every 10 feet it is moved (up to a maximum of 3d8), as a torrent of water bombards it along its trajectory. A creature can take this damage once on a turn.
Additionally, whenever you forcibly move a creature, you can spend 2 sorcery points to move them in any horizontal direction of your choosing.

14.name: Riptide Core
description: Starting at 14th level, the tides will answer your call no matter where you may be. As as action, you create a swirling mass of water that violently circles around you in a 30 foot radius for 1 minute. This area is considered difficult terrain. Any creature that starts it's turn in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw. On a failed save you can force the tides to carry them up to 30 feet in any direction within the area of effect.
Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

18.name: King of the Tide
description: At 18th level, you exist in pure harmony with your aquatic heritage; you move as the sea does, fluid and unstoppable. When you move on your turn you can expend 2 sorcery points to take on a watery form until the end of your turn.

While in this watery form, you have resistance to fire damage and bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from non-magical weapons. Additionally, you can move through any enemy's space but can't willingly end your move there. You can move through any space that is at least 3 inches in diameter and do so without squeezing.
If your Riptide Core feature is active, creatures within the area of effect must make a Strength saving throw against your Arcane spell save DC or fall prone and be dragged along with your movement.

subclasses.name: Tideborn

description: Your innate magic comes from a dark part of your ancestral past. You have a direct familial connection to a vampire, and its power has shown itself most in you. It is not a curse that you have, but the blood in your veins that connects you to them.

Having this origin is a secret that is often kept secret at all costs as many folk will point at those with vampiric blood in them and cry evil. Indeed many who trace their lineage to such creatures turn to evil in order to survive in a world that despises them. This is their choice, however, and you can choose to become what you want.
The power of your bloodline may mark you as evil, but it does not control you.

1.name: Vampiric Ancestry
description: From 1st level, when you choose this subclass, your Vampiric ancestry grants you the benefits that are shown below.

• You can cause a creature to re-roll a successful saving throw made against being charmed by Arcane spells you cast. You can't do this to the same creature again for seven days.
  • You don't need to sleep in order to gain the benefits of a long rest. Instead you can spend four hours doing simple nonstrenuous tasks such as reading a book, writing a letter, or painting a picture.

1.name: Ancestral Regeneration
description: At 1st level, your bloodline gives you incredible regenerative power. You have a pool of regeneration represented by a number of d6's equal to your sorcerer level.
As a bonus action, you can spend a number of those dice equal up to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1). You regain hit points equal to the total amount rolled.
You regain all expended dice when you finish a long rest. If you are in direct sunlight, roll d4s instead of d6s.

6.name: Misty Escape
description: Starting at 6th level, when reduced to 0 hit points you are not rendered unconscious but instead you (along with all the items you are wearing) transform into a cloud of mist. While in mist form you are immune to all damage, can take no actions other than to fly with a speed of 30 feet, and must make death saving throws as normal. At the end of your next turn, your body reforms and you become unconscious if you still have 0 health.
Once this happens, it can't happen again until you finish a long rest.

14.name: Night Walker
description: Starting at 14th level, you are always under the effects of the Spider Climb spell.

18.name: Lineage Scion
description: Starting at 18th level, you age very slowly. For every five years that pass, you age only one year.
Also, you can use your Ancestral Regeneration feature on your turn while you are unconscious or in mist form. If you do this, your turn ends afterwards and you roll d4 instead of d6s for the healing.

subclasses.name: Vampiric Bloodline

description: Sometimes the spark of magic that fuels a sorcerer comes from a primal source of the natural world. Having such a soul is a sign that your innate magic might come from a distant but powerful familial connection to a nature spirit or similar such being. Perhaps your ancestor was a fallen dryad, who transformed into a mortal for love. Or your birth might have been watched over by denizens of the Feywild, marking you as a child of a hag or a chosen vessel of fey magic.

In some cultures, only those who can claim the power of a Verdant Soul may command power from the Feywild. In these lands, these positions are dominated by a few bloodlines and preserved over generations.

1.name: Bonus Spell List
description: Your link to nature allows you to learn spells normally associated with the druid class. When your Sorcery feature lets you learn a cantrip or a spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose the new spell from the Primal spell list or the Arcane spell list. You must otherwise obey all the restrictions for selecting the spell.

1.name: Wild Companion
description: Starting at 1st level, your primal soul can manifest as a companion.  Perhaps you see it as an imaginary friend, a manifestation of your inner self, or you know its true nature.
You know the Find Familiar spell, and you can cast it at will, but only as a ritual.  When you  cast Find Familiar in this way, the familiar is a Fey, instead of a creature type of your choice.
In addition, you learn to speak, read, and write Apocalyptic or Druidic (your choice).

6.name: Spirit of the Land
description: Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard.
In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such as those created by the Entangle spell.

14.name: Fey Passage
description: Starting at 14th level, when you use metamagic on a spell of 1st level or higher, you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 15 feet.

18.name: Scion of Nature
description: At 18th level, you have become a true emissary of the natural world.  You gain resistance to bludgeoning and piercing damage, and resistance to poison damage.  Beasts and plants that you conjure with your spells do not wilt away or otherwise disappear unless you allow them to, instead remaining without any magical effects and no longer being under your control.

When you are damaged by a creature within 60 feet of you, you can use a reaction to entangle the creature in plants.  The target must make a Strength saving throw.  On a failed save, the target takes 3d6 piercing damage and is restrained until the beginning of its next turn.

subclasses.name: Verdant Soul

description: Your innate magic comes from the wild forces of chaos that underlie the order of creation. You might have endured exposure to some form of raw magic, perhaps through a planar portal leading to Limbo, the Elemental Planes, or the mysterious Far Realm. Perhaps you were blessed by a powerful fey creature or marked by a demon. Or your magic could be a fluke of your birth, with no apparent cause or reason. However it came to be, this chaotic magic churns within you, waiting for any outlet.

1.name: Wild Magic Surge
description: Starting when you choose this origin at 1st level, your spellcasting can unleash surges of untamed magic. Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, roll a d20.

If you roll a 1 on the d20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to create a magical effect. If that effect is a spell, it is too wild to be affected by your Metamagic, and if it normally requires concentration, it doesn't require concentration in this case; the spell lasts for its full duration.
If you do not roll a 1 on the d20, the threshold for a wild magic surge increases by 1. Once you have caused a wild magic surge, the threshold resets back to 1.

1.name: Tides of Chaos
description: Starting at 1st level, you can manipulate the forces of chance and chaos to gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Once you do so, you must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.
At any time after you use this feature, if you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you regain the use of this feature.

6.name: Bend Luck
description: Starting at 6th level, you have the ability to twist fate using your wild magic. When another creature you can see makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction and spend 3 sorcery points to roll 1d4 and apply the number rolled as a bonus or penalty (your choice) to the creature's roll. You can do so after the creature rolls but before any effects of the roll occur.

14.name: Controlled Chaos
description: At 14th level, you gain a modicum of control over the surges of your wild magic. Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and use either number.

18.name: Spell Bombardment
description: Beginning at 18th level, the harmful energy of your spells intensifies. When you roll damage for a spell and roll the highest number possible on any of the dice, choose one of those dice, roll it again and add that roll to the damage. You can use the feature only once per turn.

subclasses.name: Wild Magic

4.name: Ability Score Improvement
description: When you reach 4th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
Alternatively, you gain one feat of your choice.
You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
You gain one feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisities.

8.name: Ability Score Improvement
description: When you reach 8th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
Alternatively, you gain one feat of your choice.
You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
You gain one feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisities.

12.name: Ability Score Improvement
description: When you reach 12th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
Alternatively, you gain one feat of your choice.
You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
You gain one feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisities.

16.name: Ability Score Improvement
description: When you reach 16th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
Alternatively, you gain one feat of your choice.
You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
You gain one feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisities.

19.name: Ability Score Improvement
description: When you reach 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
Alternatively, you gain one feat of your choice.
You can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature.
You gain one feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisities.

1.name: Summoning Stones
description: Beginning at 1st level, you can turn the souls of monsters you kill into magical items known as Summoning Stones.

subFeatures.name: Creating Summons
