  • Whenever you make an Intelligence check, you gain a bonus to your roll equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1).

1.name: Arcane Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 force damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

3.name: Ascended Archon
description: You take on the luminous form of the ancient spellcaster that is bound to you. Your Archon Form uses the stat block below.  While transformed, your creature type changes to Humanoid.

Ascended Archon
Armor Class Bonus +0
Speed 30 ft., fly 10 ft. (hover)
Skills Arcana +PB, History +PB
Damage Resistances damage from spells
Languages Primordial, and any languages you know
Astral Step. Whenever the Archon casts a spell, it can teleport a number of feet equal to 10 times the spell level (minimum 10) to an unoccupied space it sees.
Actions
Arcane Blast. Once on its turn, the Archon forgo one attack to cause a burst of magic at a point it can see within 60 feet. Creatures within 5 feet must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take damage as if they had been hit by one of your Arcane Strikes.

6.name: Potent Magicks
description: Starting at 6th level, the ambient magic of the Ascended being within your soul empowers your magic with a fraction of its power. Whenever you deal damage with a Vessel spell, you add your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1) to one damage roll.

14.name: Ascended Arcanum
description: At 14th level, you wrest even greater magics from the Ascended within you. You learn a single 6th-level Arcane spell of your choice, which you can cast once per long rest without spending a spell slot.
At 18th level, you learn a 7th-level Arcane spell that you can also cast once per long rest without expending a spell slot.

18.name: Archmage Reborn
description: At 18th level, your soul is able to channel the full power of the Ascended bound to your mortal flesh, if only temporarily. When you are in your Archon Form you gain the following benefits:

• You assume the appearance your Ascended had in life.
  • The distance you can teleport with Astral Step is doubled.
  • As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see in range.
  • The radius of your Arcane Blast becomes 15 feet.

subclasses.name: Ascended

description: At the dawn of the multiverse, elemental forces ran wild. Great beings of pure Air, Earth, Fire, and Water ravaged through the material plane, shaping it to their frivolous and destructive will. These primordial elementals and elder genies were banished from the material plane, but are always seeking to return. When they threaten mortal realms, great forces bind these elder elemental beings to mortal hosts, holding back the Cataclysm for a time.
Familiar Types: Elemental

1.name: Elemental Affinity
description: Starting at 1st level, within you is bound an ancient elemental Spirit of overwhelming power. Choose the type of Elemental Spirit bound to you: Air, Earth, Fire, or Water.

traits.name: Electric Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 lightning damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

traits.name: Air Affinity
description: You know the Gust cantrip.  Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it, and you can cast it as a bonus action.
In addition, you can speak, read, and write Auran.

traits.name: Earthen Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 magical bludgeoning damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

traits.name: Earth Affinity
description: You know the Mold Earth cantrip.  Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it, and you can cast it as a bonus action.
In addition, you can speak, read, and write Terran.

traits.name: Fiery Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 fire damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

traits.name: Fire Affinity
description: You know the Control Flames cantrip.  Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it, and you can cast it as a bonus action.
In addition, you can speak, read, and write Ignan.

traits.name: Icy Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 cold damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

traits.name: Water Affinity
description: You know the Shape Water cantrip.  Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it, and you can cast it as a bonus action.
In addition, you can speak, read, and write Aquan.

3.name: Cataclysm Archon
description: Starting at 3rd level, you can take on a form of pure elemental power, wreathed in storms, flames, stone, or waves. When you transform into your Archon Form, you use the Cataclysm Archon stat block below that corresponds to the Elemental Affinity you chose at 1st level.  While transformed, your creature type changes to Elemental.

traits.name: Air Archon
description:
Air Archon
Armor Class Bonus +0
Speed 20 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover)
Skills Acrobatics +PB, Stealth +PB
Senses darkvision 60 ft.
Damage Resistances thunder, lightning
Languages Auran, and any languages you know
Air Form. The Archon can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, and it does not provoke opportunity attacks while it is flying.
Cataclysm Elemental. Whenever the Archon deals lighting or thunder damage, it ignores resistance, and treats immunity to those damage types as resistance.
Bluster. Whenever the Archon deals thunder damage to a creature with an Electric Strike, it can knock it back 10 feet in a straight line. This distance is halved for each size the target is above the Archon.

traits.name: Earth Archon
description:
Earth Archon
Armor Class Bonus +3
Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft., burrow 10 ft.
Skills Athletics +PB, Survival +PB
Senses darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 10 ft.
Damage Resistances bludgeoning, piercing, slashing
Languages Terran, and any languages you know
Rock Solid. Whenever the Archon deals bludgeoning damage to a creature with an Earthen Strike, it can halve its speed until the start of your next turn. It can impose this effect on each creature once per turn.
Cataclysm Elemental. Whenever the Archon deals acid or bludgeoning damage, it ignores resistance, and treats immunity to those damage types as resistance.
Siege Monster. When the Archon deals bludgeoning damage to a non-magical object or structure, it deals the maximum possible damage instead of rolling.

traits.name: Fire Archon
description:
Fire Archon
Armor Class Bonus +1
Speed 40 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover)
Skills Acrobatics +PB, Intimidation +PB
Senses darkvision 60 ft.
Damage Resistances fire, radiant
Languages Ignan, and any languages you know
Ignite. Whenever the Archon deals fire damage to a creature with an Fiery Strike, it can ignite it if it is flammable. Ignited targets take fire damage equal to your Charisma modifier at the end of each of their turns until they drop prone or a creature uses its action to extinguish the flames.
Cataclysm Elemental. Whenever the Archon deals fire or radiant damage, it ignores resistance, and treats immunity to those damage types as resistance.
Illumination. The Archon sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 ft.

traits.name: Water Archon
description:
Water Archon
Armor Class Bonus +1
Speed 30 ft., swim 40 ft.
Skills Medicine +PB, Nature +PB
Senses darkvision 60 ft.
Damage Resistances acid, cold
Languages Aquan, and any languages you know
Aqueous. The Archon can breathe normally in air and water, and it can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.
Cataclysm Elemental. Whenever the Archon deals bludgeoning or cold damage, it ignores resistance, and treats immunity to those damage types as resistance.
Watery Resilience. When the Archon takes damage, it can use its reaction to reduce the damage by an amount equal to your Charisma modifier and move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

6.name: Elder Power
description: Starting at 6th level, the natural elements present in the material plane are but a pale imitation of your Spirit's primordial power. When you cast a Vessel spell or use a feature that deals your Elemental Affinity damage type, or cast one of your Cataclysm Spells, you can treat a roll of 1 or 2 on any of the damage dice you roll for that spell or feature as a 3.

Also, whenever you deal your Elemental Affinity damage type to a creature, or deal damage with one of your Cataclysm spells, you can ignore resistance to that damage, and you treat immunity to that damage type as resistance.

14.name: Elemental Eruption
description: Starting at 14th level, raw primordial energies erupt from your Spirit. As an action, you can cause a 15-foot diameter, 60-foot high, pillar of raw elemental power to erupt from a point you can see within 30 feet, forcing creatures in that area to make a Dexterity saving throw. They take 8d6 damage of your Elemental Affinity type on a failure, and half as much on a successful save.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all of your expended uses when you finish a long rest.

18.name: Cataclysm Reborn
description: At 18th level, you wield the full power of a primordial elemental force, and the raw elements of the planes bend to your will. When you are in your Archon Form you gain the following benefits:

• You assume the true appearance of your Cataclysm.
  • The weather in a 1-mile radius surrounding you subtly changes to reflect your primordial elemental influence.
  • You can use your Elemental Eruption action at will.

subclasses.name: Cataclysm

description: While most gods are content to work through chosen Clerics and Paladins, some prefer a more direct method of influence. When they have found a suitable mortal host, they undergo an ancient celestial ritual which allows them to sever a part of their essence, forming a Divine Spark, which they imbue nto their chosen mortal host. Eventually, this Divine Spark will grow giving the mortal access to wondrous divine power.
Familiar Types: Celestial

1.name: Divine Spark
description: Starting at 1st level, you have been chosen to serve as a the Conduit for a deity of the upper planes and have been imbued with a Divine Spark of their wondrous power. You gain the following benefits:

• When your Vessel Magic feature lets you learn an occult spell of 1st level or higher, you can choose the new spell from the Divine spell list or the Occult spell list. You must otherwise obey all the restrictions for selecting the spell, and it becomes an occult spell for you.
  • Choose a Divine Domain from among those available to the Cleric class that best represents the domain of your god. This will influence later Conduit Spirit features.

1.name: Divine Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in divine power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 damage.  The type of damage is determined by the alignment of the god you serve as a conduit for: either radiant (good), thunder (neutral), or necrotic (evil).
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

2.name: Spirit Spells
description: At 2nd level, in place of the normal list of Spirit Spells, your Divine Spark infuses you with the knowledge of spells related to your god. Choose a Divine Domain from the cleric class, for which you gain its Domain Spells.

3.name: Conduit Archon
description: You are able to channel a portion of the true presence of your deity through your Archon transformation. Your Archon Form uses the stat block below.  While transformed, your creature type changes to Celestial.

Conduit Archon
Armor Class Bonus +0
Speed 30 ft., fly 10 ft. (hover)
Skills Insight +PB, Religion +PB
Damage Resistances radiant, necrotic
Languages Celestial, and any languages you know
Celestial Regeneration. When the Archon casts a Vessel spell of 1st level or higher, its temporary hit points increase by an amount equal to twice the level of the spell.
Channel Divinity. The Archon can use the 2nd-level Channel Divinity option from your chosen Divine Domain. It can only do so once per transformation. If the Channel Divinity takes longer than 1 action to take effect, its casting time is reduced to 1 action.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Cataclysmic Eruption
description: You gain this Channel Divinity option. When you deal fire or bludgeoning damage, you can use this Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage, instead of rolling.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Arcane Abjuration
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to abjure otherworldly creatures.

As an action, you present your holy symbol, and one celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend of your choice that is within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw, provided that the creature can see or hear you. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly end its move in a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can only use the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

After you reach 5th level, when a creature fails its saving throw against your Arcane Abjuration feature, the creature is banished for 1 minute (as in the Banishment spell, no concentration required) if it isn't on its plane of origin and its challenge rating is at or below a certain threshold, as shown on the Arcane Banishment table.

Arcane Banishment
vessel levelBanishes Creatures of CR…
5th1/2 or lower
8th1 or lower
11th2 or lower
14th3 or lower
17th4 or lower

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Divine Inspiration
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to call upon your god to inspire a creature.  When a creature within 30 feet of you makes an ability check, you can use your reaction to fill it with divine inspiration, moving it to creation and resourcefulness.  The target can treat a roll of 8 or lower on their ability check as a 9.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Inner Beauty
description: You can use your action to change the physical appearance and self-image of a creature you see within 30 feet of you, revealing its true grace or exposing its ugliness for 10 minutes. Choose one of the following effects:

• The creature must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or become insecure and have its body and visage slightly twisted and deformed, gaining disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma ability checks for the duration.
  • The creature is filled with confidence and it becomes lovelier and more elegant, gaining advantage on Dexterity and Charisma ability checks for the duration.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Touch of Death
description: You can use Channel Divinity to destroy another creature's life force by touch. When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can use Channel Divinity to deal extra necrotic damage to the target. The damage equals 5 + twice your vessel level.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Prophecy of Doom
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to speak a prophecy, inducing visions and hallucinations in nearby creatures.

As an action, choose a point within 120 feet of you that you can see and roll on the Eldritch Effects table. Each creature in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the chosen point must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or suffer the temporary effect for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature can make another Wisdom saving throw, ending the temporary effect on a success.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Divine Inferno
description: You can use your channel divinity to invoke the inferno of your god's flame.
When you roll fire or radiant damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage, instead of rolling.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to create simple items.

You conduct an hour-long ritual that crafts a nonmagical item that must include some metal: a simple or martial weapon, a suit of armor, ten pieces of ammunition, a set of tools, or another metal object. The creation is completed at the end of the hour, coalescing in an unoccupied space of your choice on a surface within 5 feet of you.

The thing you create can be something that is worth no more than 100 gp. As part of this ritual, you must lay out metal, which can include coins, with a value equal to the creation. The metal irretrievably coalesces and transforms into the creation at the ritual's end, magically forming even nonmetal parts of the creation.
The ritual can create a duplicate of a nonmagical item that contains metal, such as a key, if you possess the original during the ritual.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to mark another creature's life force for termination.

As an action, you choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you, cursing it until the end of your next turn. The next time you or an ally of yours hits the cursed creature with an attack, the creature has vulnerability to all of that attack's damage, and then the curse ends.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Hearthflame
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to summon a shred of hearthfire to protect you and allies.

As an action, you present you holy symbol and conjure a warm flame to follow you.  While the flame is active, it sheds bright light in a 30 foot radius and dim light 30 feet beyond that.  You can freely move the flame to any spot of your choice within 10 feet of you (no action required).  The flame endures for 1 hour, or until you use this feature again.

When a creature you can see within the light of the flame fails a saving throw, you can use your reaction to intervene with the flame's power.  You immediately make a Wisdom saving throw, and you can choose to replace the result of the failed saving throw with the result of that roll.  After you do so, the flames dim and radius of light is reduced by 10 feet.  If the radius is reduced to 0 feet, the flame is extinguished.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Rally
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to inspire an ally with resolve and hope.
As an action, you can present your holy symbol and select a creature you can see within 60 feet. Until the end of your next turn, the target makes all attack rolls and saving throws with advantage.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Spell Shield
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to bestow a temporary resilience to arcane harm. As a bonus action, you present your holy symbol and choose a creature you can see (including yourself) within 30 feet. The chosen creature gains temporary hit points equal to 1d10 + your vessel level. While a creature has temporary hit points granted by your spell shield, it has resistance to damage from spells and advantage on saving throws against spells. The creature loses any remaining temporary hit points after 1 hour.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Chains of Reckoning
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to invoke judgement upon your enemies. As an action, you present your holy symbol, causing a creature you can see within 60 feet of you to be crushed beneath the weight of their sins. For 1 minute, you can apply the bonus damage of Sacred Judgement to that creature when dealing damage with a spell.

The chosen creature must also make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is knocked prone and their movement speed becomes 0 for 1 minute. The creature can repeat their saving throw at the end of each of their turns. If the creature has dealt damage since the start of their turn, they make this save at disadvantage.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to tap into a divine well of knowledge. As an action, you choose one skill or tool. For 10 minutes, you have proficiency with the chosen skill or tool.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to heal the badly injured.

As an action, you present your holy symbol and evoke healing energy that can restore a number of hit points equal to five times your vessel level. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those hit points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half of its hit point maximum. You can't use this feature on an undead or a construct.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to harness sunlight, banishing darkness and dealing radiant damage to your foes.

As an action, you present your holy symbol, and any magical darkness within 30 feet of you is dispelled. Additionally, each hostile creature within 30 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes radiant damage equal to 2d10 + your vessel level on a failed saving throw, and half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that has total cover from you is not affected.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Lucky Break
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to inspire an ally with resolve and hope. As an action, you can present your holy symbol and select a creature you can see within 60 feet. Until the end of your next turn, the target makes all attack rolls and saving throws with advantage.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Far Rift
description: You can use your Channel Divinity as an action to present your holy symbol and open up a rift in space. Choose a point centered on an unoccupied 10-foot cube within 60 feet of you. The rift appears as a 5-foot radius sphere of blackness with long, lashing tendrils.

Choose a number of creatures you can see up to your spellcasting ability modifier within 30 feet of the sphere. Each target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 20 feet toward the sphere. A creature that is pulled into the sphere's space takes psychic damage equal to 2d8 + your vessel level. The rift then closes.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Voice of the Mountain
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to shake the ground with the voice of the mountain, injuring those who cannot keep their balance.

As an action, you present your holy symbol and the ground in a 30-foot cube within 60 feet of you rumbles with divine power. Each creature on the ground in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, a creature takes thunder damage equal to 2d6 + your vessel level and it is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone. Until the end of your next tum, ground in the area is difficult terrain as it continues to quake.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to charm animals and plants.

As an action, you present your holy symbol and invoke the name of your deity. Each creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or less that can see you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is charmed by you for 1 minute or until it takes damage. While it is charmed by you, it is friendly to you and other creatures you designate.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to exert an intimidating presence over others.

As an action, you present your holy symbol, and each creature of your choice that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you until the end of your next turn or until the charmed creature takes any damage. You can also cause any of the charmed creatures to drop what they are holding when they fail the saving throw.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Tendrils of Agony
description: As an action, you can present your holy symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to unleash a wave of agony that ripples outward from you. Choose a number of creatures up to your Wisdom modifier within 30 feet of you. These creatures must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes psychic damage equal to 2d6 + your vessel level and the creature is incapacitated for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.
An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Balm of Peace
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to make your very presence a soothing balm. As an action, you can move up to your speed, without provoking opportunity attacks, and when you move within 5 feet of any other creature during this action, you can restore a number of hit points to that creature equal to 2d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum of 1 hit point). A creature can receive this healing only once whenever you take this action.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Unleash the Plague
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to afflict your foes with terrible sickness.

As a reaction when you deal poison or necrotic damage to a creature within 30 feet of you with a spell, you can use your Channel Divinity to infect it with one of the following diseases of your choice. The disease lasts for a number of days equal to half your vessel level. The target also makes a Constitution saving throw each time it finishes a long rest, ending the disease on a success.

During combat, an afflicted creature can attempt to resist the effects of the disease by making a Constitution saving throw at the start of its turn. On a successful save the effects of the disease are suppressed for one minute, or until you deal poison or necrotic damage to the creature.

A creature is unaffected by this feature if it is already suffering from a disease. Once a creature has been subjected to Unleash the Plague, it is immune to further uses of this feature for 24 hours.

subFeatures.name: Atrophy
description: The target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks that use Strength or Dexterity.

subFeatures.name: Lethargy
description: The target's speed is halved and it cannot take reactions.

subFeatures.name: Migraine
description: The target has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks that use Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. It also has disadvantage on any Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain concentration.

subFeatures.name: Nausea
description: The target has disadvantage on saving throws against poison, as well as any saving throw it makes to avoid regurgitation or similar effects.

subFeatures.name: Necrosis
description: Whenever the target takes necrotic or poison damage, including the triggering damage, its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the disease is cured. Additionally, whenever it fails a saving throw against this feature the target takes 1d6 necrotic damage.

subFeatures.name: Psychosis
description: The target gains a random form of Indefinite Madness that lasts until the disease is cured. During combat, if a creature moves 5 feet or more while within the target's reach, it must use its reaction to make a melee attack against that creature.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Radiant Defense
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to cloak your allies in radiant armor.

As an action, you channel blessed energy into an ally that you can see within 30 feet of you. The first time that ally is hit by an attack within the next minute, the attacker takes radiant damage equal to 2d10 + your vessel level.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Tidal Surge
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to create a wave of temporary water around you.

As an action, you present your holy symbol, and each creature of your choice within 15 feet of you must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to 2d6 + your vessel level, and it is pushed 10 feet away from you or pulled up to 10 feet toward you (you choose which it is each time you use this ability) On a success, it takes half as much damage and isn't pushed or pulled.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Cloying Darkness
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to conjure a cloud of darkness to billow around you, banishing light and draining the life of your foes. As an action, you present your holy symbol and all light sources within 30 feet are extinguished, and magical lights produced by a spell of a level equal to half your vessel level or lower are dispelled.

In addition, creatures of your choice within 30 feet must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes necrotic damage equal to 2d6 + your vessel level on a failed saving throw, and loses any darkvision they have for 1 minute.
On a successful save, they take half as much damage and suffer no other effects. A creature can repeat this saving throw at the start of each of its turns, regaining their darkvision on a success.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Updraft
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to create a powerful blast of wind. As an action, you present your holy symbol and invoke the name of your deity. Choose a Large or smaller creature within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be blown upwards up to 30 feet. A target can choose to automatically fail this saving throw. If the target doesn't have a hover or fly speed, it immediately falls afterwards, taking fall damage and landing prone.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Blessed Aesop
description: You can use your channel divinity to regale a ally with an inspiring story that helps to guide their actions and decisions. As an bonus action, you can quickly tell your story to a friendly creature within 30 feet who can hear you. The target gains advantage on the next attack roll, ability, or saving throw they make in the next minute.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Feat of Strength
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to enhance your physical might. When you make an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw using Strength, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the roll succeeds or fails.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Wave of Despair
description: As an action, you can present your holy symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to unleash a wave of despair that ripples outward from you. Choose a number of creatures up to your Wisdom modifier within 30 feet of you. These creatures must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d8 psychic damage and the creature must spend its action on its turn wallowing in sadness and grief for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to wield the power of the storm with unchecked ferocity.
When you roll lightning or thunder damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to deal maximum damage, instead of rolling.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Rewind Time
description: You can use Channel Divinity to reverse a moment in time.

At the end of your turn, you can choose to go back in time to the start of your turn. Any actions taken, spells cast, damage dealt, or movement expended are reset to their states at the beginning of your turn. You then start your turn again as normal.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Safe Passage
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to secure magical safe passage.

As an action, you present your holy symboL and you teleport one willing creature that you can see within 30 feet of you up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. Until the end of your next turn, attack rolls are made against it with disadvantage, and it has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by nonmagical weapons. If the target makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, or deals damage to another creature, the effect ends immediately.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to create an illusory duplicate of yourself.

As an action, you create a perfect illusion of yourself that lasts for 1 minute, or until you lose your concentration (as if you were concentrating on a spell). The illusion appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of you. As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet to a space you can see, but it must remain within 120 feet of you.

For the duration, you can cast spells as though you were in the illusion's space, but you must use your own senses. Additionally, when both you and your illusion are within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have advantage on attack rolls against that creature, given how distracting the illusion is to the target.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Twilight Sanctuary
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to refresh your allies with soothing twilight.

As an action, you present your holy symbol, and a sphere of twilight emanates from you. The sphere is centered on you, has a 30-foot radius, and is filled with dim light. The sphere moves with you, and it lasts for 1 minute or until you are incapacitated or die. Whenever a creature (including you) ends its turn in the sphere, you can grant that creature one of these benefits:

• You grant it temporary hit points equal to 1d6 plus your vessel level.
  • You end one effect on it causing it to be charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to strike with supernatural accuracy. When you make an attack roll, you can use your Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Font of Prosperity
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to spread the joy of mutual benefit.

Whenever a creature within 120 feet of you that you can see regains hit points or gains temporary hit points, you can use your Channel Divinity as a reaction to grant the same effect to another creature you can see within 120 feet of you.

traits.name: Channel Divinity: Ice Prison
description: You can use your Channel Divinity to encase a creature in ice. As an action, you brandish your holy symbol, and force a creature you can see within 30 feet of you to make a Strength saving throw. A willing creature can choose to fail their saving throws against this feature.

On a failed saving throw, the creature is encased in ice for 1 minute, or until you dispel it with an action. While encased in this way, the creature is immune to all damage, is incapacitated, and its speed becomes 0. At the end of each of its turn it can repeat the Strength saving throw, breaking free of the ice on a success.

6.name: Empowered Conduit
description: Starting at 6th level, the Divine Spark bound to your soul infuses your magic with divine power depending on the alignment of your god. When you cast a spell that deals damage, you can choose for that casting of the spell to deal the same damage type as your Divine Strikes, in place of the spell's normal damage.

Also, when you deal the damage type of your Divine Strikes to certain creatures: Fiends and Undead for Radiant, Celestials and Fiends for Thunder, and Celestials and Fey for Necrotic; you can treat a roll of 2 or lower on the damage dice as a 3.

14.name: Anointed One
description: Starting at 14th level, you are able to draw more power from your Divine Spark to use in service to your god. You learn a single 6th-level spell of your choice from the Divine spell list, and you can cast that spell once, at 6th-level, without expending a spell slot. Once you cast this Divine spell in this way you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again.
At 18th level, you learn a Divine spell of 7th-level, following the same rules as the 6th-level spell you learned.

18.name: Celestial Champion
description: At 18th level, you are able to directly channel the power of your deity into the world, if only temporarily. When you are in your Archon Form you gain the following additional benefits:

• You assume the true appearance of your Deity.
  • You can cast your 1st-level Divine Domain spells at-will, at 1st-level, without expending a spell slot.
  • Once per Archon Form transformation, you can cast the Divine Word spell without expending a spell slot.

subclasses.name: Conduit

description: Condemned by the gods for their transgressions at the dawn of time, beings known as Cursed were wielders of dark and sinister power. Counted among the Cursed are the demons, devils, and all other nefarious spirits of the lower planes. To be counted among the Cursed, these sinister spirits posed a particular threat to the order of the cosmos, and were often sealed away to prevent untold calamity and suffering.
Familiar Types: Fiend

1.name: Malignant Aura
description: Starting at 1st level, the aura of the Cursed Spirit sealed within your soul bleeds into your personality. You learn to speak Abyssal, Carcerin, or Infernal. You also gain proficiency in Deception or Intimidation, and whenever you make an ability check with either skill you can treat a roll of 7 or lower on the d20 as an 8.

1.name: Hellfire Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 fire damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

3.name: Cursed Archon
description: You can take on a sinister form wreathed in the dark flame and shadow of your Cursed Spirit. When you transform into Archon Form, you use the Cursed Archon stat block below.  While transformed, your creature type changes to Fiend.

Cursed Archon
Armor Class Bonus +1
Speed 40 ft., climb 40 ft.
Skills Religion +PB, Stealth +PB
Damage Resistances fire, poison
Senses darkvision 120 ft.
Languages any languages you know
Infernal Drain. Once per turn when the Archon hits a creature with a Hellfire Strike, its temporary hit points are increased by an amount equal to half the damage dealt.
Frenzy. When the Archon takes the Attack action, it can choose enter a Frenzy which lasts until the start of your next turn. For the duration, all of its attacks, and all attacks against the Archon have advantage.

6.name: Hellfire
description: Starting at 6th level, you can access the true power of the dark Spirit imprisoned within, conjuring cursed infernal flames. When you deal fire damage to a creature with a Vessel spell or another Vessel feature, you ignore the target's fire resistance, and you treat the target's immunity to fire damage as resistance.
Also, if you deal fire damage to a creature it cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

6.name: Infernal Claws
description: The twisted power of your Archon Form increases, granting you the following benefits while you are transformed:

• You can climb difficult surfaces, including sheer walls, and upside down on ceilings, without making an ability check.
  • When you make an Athletics check to shove or grapple a target, you treat a roll of 7 or lower on the d20 as an 8.
  • You count as one size larger for the purpose of grappling.

14.name: Dark Sacrifice
description: Starting at 14th level, you can sacrifice your own life force to your Cursed Spirit in return for more power. As a bonus action, you can regain one of your expended Vessel Magic spell slots by reducing both your current and maximum hit points by an amount equal to twice the level of the spell slot you regain. This reduction to your hit points cannot be lessened in any way.
At the end of your next long rest any reduction to your hit point maximum from this feature returns to normal.

18.name: Lord of Darkness
description: At 18th level, your combined power allows this Cursed Spirit to walk in the material world once again. When you are in your Archon Form you gain the following benefits:

• You assume the appearance of your Cursed Spirit.
  • You gain immunity to the charmed, frightened, and poisoned conditions, and to fire and poison damage.
  • When you take the Attack action on your turn you can make one bonus Hellfire Strike as part of your action.
  • Once per turn when you deal fire damage to a creature with a Hellfire Strike you can cause it to be frightened of you until the beginning of your next turn.

subclasses.name: Cursed

description: Not all denizens of the upper planes serve the will of the gods that created them. Those who stray to far from their divinely ordained purpose invoke divine wrath. Known as the Fallen, these wayward celestials are hurled down from the heavens and imprisoned in mortal form to atone for their many sins.
Familiar Types: Celestial

1.name: Radiant Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 radiant damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

1.name: Celestial Warrior
description: Starting at 1st level, your Spirit imbues you with the martial skill of the heavenly hosts. You gain proficiency with all martial weapons.

When you make a melee weapon attack, you can empower the attack so it counts as a Radiant Strike. When you do so, you use your Charisma for the attack and damage roll of that attack, but you use the weapon's normal damage dice, and the weapon deals radiant damage instead of its normal damage type.
Finally, you can speak, read, and write Celestial, and you gain proficiency in Insight.  If you make a Wisdom (Insight) check you add your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1) to your roll.

3.name: Fallen Archon
description: You take on a form wreathed in rings of fire or a humanoid that radiates golden light. When you transform into your Archon Form, you use the Fallen Archon stat block below.  While transformed, your creature type changes to Celestial.

Fallen Archon
<Armor Class Bonus +2
Speed 30 ft.
Skills Intimidation +PB, Religion +PB
Damage Resistances necrotic, radiant
Languages any languages you know
Celestial Ward. As a bonus action on its turn, the Archon can grant one target that it can see within 30 feet temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).
Divine Challenge If the Archon deals radiant damage to a creature with a Radiant Strike, that creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than the Archon until the start of your next turn.

6.name: Holy Zeal
description: At 6th level, divine power infuses your weapons with a desire for justice. When you use a melee weapon to make a Radiant Strike it gains the Thrown (30/90) property, and after you make a ranged attack with it, it instantly returns to your hand.
Also, your attacks against any creature marked by Divine Challenge score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20 on the d20. This increases at 14th level (18-20) and 18th level (17-20).

14.name: Heavenly Warrior
description: Starting at 14th level, your Fallen Spirit compels you to slay all who stand against you. If a Condemned creature dies, you can use your reaction to Condemn another creature that you can see within 30 feet.
Also, your Blades of Judgment score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20 on the d20 against Condemned creatures.

18.name: Divine Avenger
description: At 18th level, your soul is able to fully channel the radiant light of the Fallen bound to your mortal flesh, if only temporarily. When you are in your Archon Form you gain the following benefits:

• You assume the true appearance of your Fallen Spirit.
  • When you miss a target with a weapon attack, the next attack you make against that creature has advantage.
  • Whenever you score a critical hit against a creature, it is blinded, deafened, and silenced for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, ending one condition on each successful save.

subclasses.name: Fallen

description: Before the world was shaped, horrible things slithered about the darkness. Formless monsters with only one desire, to eat and consume anything they could. These shapeless creatures of hunger are known as Formless, and even now, they gnaw the roots of the world, trapped deep below the material plane.
Familiar Types: Ooze

1.name: Acidic Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 acid damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

1.name: Amorphous Shape
description: Starting at 1st level, the oozing Spirit bound to your soul allows you to bend and squeeze your body in unnatural ways. You can move through gaps as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing, though you cannot bring objects with you unless they fit through the gap.

As a bonus action, you can manifest (or dismiss) a tendril from any point on your body. It has a reach of 10 feet and its Strength score is equal to your Charisma score. You can only have one tendril manifested at a time, and this tendril can be attacked as part of you.
The tendril cannot use fine tools, weapons, or shields, but it can be used to manipulate simple objects. Your tendril can also make Acidic Strikes, shove, and grapple.

3.name: Formless Archon
description: You morph into a shapeless form of slime or an unspeakable flowing mass of opaque ooze. When you transform into your Archon Form you use the Formless Archon stat block below.  While transformed, your creature type changes to Ooze.

Formless Archon
Armor Class Bonus +1
Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft.
Skills Deception +PB, Stealth +PB
Damage Resistances acid, cold, poison
Languages any languages you know
Pseudopod. The Archon has a number of additional pseudopods equal to your Charisma modifier. These pseudopods can only make Acidic Strikes, and have a reach of 10 feet. Attacks can target these pseudopod limbs to attack the Archon directly.
Sticky Slime. When the Archon hits a creature equal to its size or smaller with a melee Acidic Strike, the target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be grappled. As an action, a grappled creature can make a Strength saving throw, escaping on a success.

6.name: Consume Vitality
description: At 6th level, while in Archon Form, you can use a bonus action to force any creatures under the effect of your spell or grappled by you to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take 2d8 acid damage and your temporary hit points increase by half the total acid damage dealt. Your temporary hit points cannot exceed twice your level.
This acid damage increases at certain Vessel levels: at 9th (3d8), 13th (4d8), 17th (5d8), and 20th level (6d8).

14.name: Consume Strike
description: Starting at 14th level, your Formless Spirit hungers for the power of your foes. When you are hit by an attack while you are in your Archon Form, you can use your reaction to temporarily consume the memory of the attack. The first Iridescent Strike you make before the end of your next turn morphs into a gelatinous mockery of the attack you consumed, and on hit, it deals the damage of the consumed attack along with any of its effects.

18.name: Primordial Hunger
description: At 18th level, you and the Formless Spirit bound to you have become one flesh, one spirit, and one unquenchable hunger. When you are in your Archon Form you gain the following benefits:

• You assume the true appearance of your Formless Spirit.
  • You gain immunity to acid damage, and whenever you deal acid damage, you ignore resistance to acid damage and you treat immunity to acid damage as resistance.
  • You are unaffected by difficult terrain, and you cannot have your speed reduced, nor can you become grappled, paralyzed, or restrained.
  • You can spend 5 feet of your movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints.
  • Being underwater imposes no penalties on your movement or attacks.
  • As an action on your turn, you can make one Acidic Strike with each one of your Archon's Pseudopods.

subclasses.name: Formless

description: First born of all mortal creatures dragons are capable of both great good and terrible evil. Thess extremely long-lived beings have a natural affinity for arcane magic, and when they reach their full maturity, they can ascend beyond their mortal forms to become forces of great power. These Greatwyrms can't be slain by normal means and must instead be sealed away.
Familiar Types: Dragon

1.name: Draconic Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 damage.  The damage type is determined by your draconic essence type.

traits.name: Black Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is acid.

traits.name: Blue Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is lightning.

traits.name: Green Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is poison.

traits.name: Red Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is fire.

traits.name: White Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is cold.

traits.name: Amethyst Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is force.

traits.name: Diamond Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is radiant.

traits.name: Emerald Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is psychic.

traits.name: Moonstone Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is radiant.

traits.name: Obsidian Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is fire.

traits.name: Ruby Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is fire.

traits.name: Sapphire Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is thunder.

traits.name: Topaz Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is necrotic.

traits.name: Brass Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is fire.

traits.name: Bronze Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is lightning.

traits.name: Copper Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is acid.

traits.name: Gold Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is fire.

traits.name: Platinum Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is radiant.

traits.name: Silver Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is cold.

traits.name: Steel Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is poison.

traits.name: Tungsten Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is thunder.

traits.name: Deep Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is psychic.

traits.name: Shadow Dragon Legacy
description: Your draconic damage type is necrotic.

3.name: Draconic Archon
description: You draw on the power of the Ancient Wyrm bound to you to take on a Draconic form. Whenever you transform into your Archon Form you use the Draconic Archon stat block below. While transformed, your creature type changes to Dragon.

Draconic Archon
Armor Class Bonus +3
Speed 30 ft., climb 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Skills Arcana +PB, Intimidation +PB
Damage Resistances draconic essence type
Condition Immunities frightened
Languages Draconic, any languages you know
Dragon's Breath. As a bonus action, the Archon can expend a Vessel Magic spell slot to exhale a torrent of energy in an adjacent 30-foot cone or a 60-foot line (your choice), forcing creatures in that area to make a Dexterity saving throw. Creatures take damage of your Essence type equal to 2d8 per level of the Vessel Magic spell slot expended on a failure, and half as much damage on a successful save.
Furious Strikes. Once per turn when the Archon hits a creature with a Draconic Strike, it can force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is frightened of the Archon until the beginning of the Archon's next turn. Once a creature succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw against the Archon's Furious Strikes, it is immune to it frightened effect until the following dawn.

6.name: Elemental Potency
description: At 6th level, you can draw out even more elemental power from the Wyrm bound within you. Whenever you deal your Essence damage type, you can treat a roll of 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3.
Moreover, when you use your action to cast a Vessel spell, you can make one Draconic Strike attack as a bonus action.

14.name: Iridescent Wings
description: Starting at 14th level, you gain a flying speed of 60 feet and can hover.

18.name: Ancient Tyrant
description: At 18th level, your power allows your Spirit to walk in the material world once again. Your Archon Form gains the following benefits:

• You assume the true appearance of your Greatwyrm.
  • You are immune to the charmed and poisoned conditions, and to both your Draconic Essence and poison damage.
  • You can use your Iridescent Breath at will, as if you had spent a 5th-level slot, without expending a spell slot.

subclasses.name: Greatwyrm

description: When they reach the end of their mortal lives, evil mages will extend their lives by undergoing the dark ritual of becoming a Lich. In order for this transformation to take effect, the mage must bind their soul to another object, or even sometimes a creature. You are one such creature that bears the soul of a great Lich, a living phylactery that anchors them to undeath.
Familiar Types: Undead

1.name: Living Phylactery
description: Starting at 1st level, your body serves as the mortal phylactery for an ancient Lich, and you gain a fraction of its power. You learn the chill touch cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting modifier for it.

Moreover, you don't require food, water, air, or sleep, although you still require rest to reduce exhaustion and to benefit from finishing short and long rests. You also age at a slower rate. For every 10 years that pass, your body ages only 1 year

1.name: Soulful Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 necrotic damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

3.name: Lich Archon
description: You draw on the power within to conjure up a specter of your master's form. When you transform into your Archon Form you use the Undying Archon stat block listed on this page.  While transformed, Undead is added to your creature type(s).

Lich Archon
Armor Class Bonus +0
Speed 30 ft.
Skills Arcana +PB, Religion +PB
Damage Resistances cold, necrotic
Languages Dark Speech, and any languages you know
Undead Rejuvenation. At the start of each of its turns, the Archon gains a number of temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).
Withering Touch. Once per turn, when the Archon hits a creature with a Soulful Strike it can force it to make a Constitution saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.
Bonus Actions
Eldritch Gaze. As a bonus action, the Archon can force one creature that can see it within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is frightened of the Archon until the start of your next turn. If a creature succeeds on this saving throw it is immune to this effect until the next dawn.

6.name: Undying Thrall
description: Starting at 6th level, you raise undead thralls of your own. You can cast animate dead at 3rd-level, or the level of your Vessel Magic spell slots (whichever is higher), without expending a spell slot.
You regain the ability to cast this spell again when you have finished at least one long rest and all of the undead that you have created from this spell have been destroyed.

14.name: Eldritch Arcanum
description: You are able to draw even greater power from the soul bound within you. You learn one 6th-level necromancy spell of your choice from any spell list, and you can cast it once, at 6th-level, without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast this spell in his way when you finish a long rest.
At 18th level, you learn a 7th-level necromancy spell fromany spell list and can cast it with the same restrictions.

18.name: Lord of Undeath
description: At 18th level, you are able to draw out the full power of the Lich's soul that is bound within your body and soul. When you are in your Archon Form you gain the following additional benefits:

• You assume the appearance your Lich has.
  • When a creature fails its saving throw against Withering Touch or Eldritch Gaze, the effects last for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turn, ending the effect on a successful save.
  • As a bonus action, you can force non-undead creatures of your choice within 30 feet to make a Constitution saving throw. Creatures take 6d6 necrotic damage on a failure, and half as much damage on a successful save.

subclasses.name: Lich

description: When the order of existence is threatened, it is inevitable that a mortal hero will rise up in defense of the realm. Once they vanquish the threat, these heroes often return to a mundane life and live out their remaining days in bucolic happiness. However, some Mythic Heroes have their Spirit called back and bound to a mortal to stand against great evil once again.
Familiar Types: Any

1.name: Warrior's Strike
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 magical slashing damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

1.name: Heroic Regalia
description: Starting at 1st level, the Mythic Hero bound to your soul grants you its knowledge of war. You gain proficiency with heavy armor and shields.

You can also use Warrior's Strike to empower a weapon attack, causing it to deal magical damage. If the damage die of the weapon is smaller than your Warrior's Strike damage die, you use the damage die of your Warrior's Strike instead.

2.name: Mythic Exploits
description: Starting at 2nd level, your Spirit imbues you with some of the skills that made them into a legendary hero, allowing you to use Exploits. You gain the following features:

subFeatures.name: Exploit Dice
description: You have two d4 Exploit Dice. To use an Exploit you must expend one of these dice, and you regain all expended Exploit Dice when you finish a short or long rest.

subFeatures.name: Mastered Exploits
description: You know the Feat of Strength and Martial Focus exploits.  You can use each of these exploits once per turn without expending an Exploit Die.  Starting at 17th level, you also gain the Heroic Will exploit as a Mastered Exploit.

subFeatures.name: Martial Exploits
description: You learn two Exploits of your choice from the list of Martial Exploits. You can only use one Exploit per ability check or attack. When you gain a level, you can replace an Exploit you know with another of your choice.

subFeatures.name: Saving Throws
description: Some of your Exploits require your target to make a saving throw to resist your Martial Exploit's effects. The saving throw DC is calculated as follows:
Exploit save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice).

3.name: Heroic Archon
description: You take the form of a legendary hero. When you transform into Archon Form, you use the Heroic Archon stat block:

Heroic Archon
Armor Class Bonus +3
Speed 40 ft.
Skills Athletics +PB, History +PB
Condition Immunities frightened, stunned
Languages any languages you know
Legendary Resilience. When the Archon fails an ability check or saving throw that uses Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution, it can expend a Vessel Magic spell slot or an Exploit Die to change its d20 roll to a 20.
Fabled Warrior. The Archon can use a bonus action to take the Dash action, or attempt a shove or grapple.

6.name: Mythic Skill
description: Starting at 6th level, the Mythic Hero within bestows you with a greater amount of its skill. You learn one Fighting Style of your choice from those available to the Fighter class.

Also, at the end of each long rest, you can commune with the Spirit bound within you and replace your Fighting Style with another Fighting Style available to the Fighter. In place of replacing your Fighting Style, you can replace one Exploit you know with another Exploit of the same Degree.

14.name: Improved Extra Attack
description: Starting at 14th level, your Archon wields weapons as an extension of itself. You can attack three times, instead of twice, when you take the Attack action while you are in your Archon Form.

18.name: Living Legend
description: At 18th level, the Hero of legend bound within your soul walks the world again in your flesh, if only temporarily. When you are in your Archon Form you gain the following additional benefits:

• You assume the appearance your Mythic Hero had in life.
  • You gain resistance to all damage from weapon attacks.
  • Once per turn, you can use one Exploit you know without expending an Exploit Die, rolling a d6 for the Exploit Die.
  • You are unaffected by difficult terrain, and you cannot have your speed reduced, nor can you become grappled, paralyzed, or restrained.
  • You can spend 5 feet of your movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints.
  • Being underwater imposes no penalties on your movement or attacks.

subclasses.name: Mythic Hero

description: Within you is sealed a mysterious entity who's true origin is unknown. It survives by draining the power of other entities to survive through the eons. You have learned to draw on this power to absorb the very life, magic, and power of creatures around you, and channel their power as if it were your own.
Familiar Types: Aberration, Fiend

1.name: Parasitic Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 necrotic damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

In addition, once per turn when you hit a creature with a Parasitic Strike you can choose to gain temporary hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. When you drain the life of a creature in this way, you learn of any resistances, immunities, or vulnerabilities that it has.

3.name: Parasitic Archon
description: You draw on the endless hunger sealed within your soul to transform into a hideous form. When you transform into your Archon Form you use the Parasitic Archon stat block above. While transformed, your creature type changes to Aberration.

Parasitic Archon
Armor Class Bonus +1
Speed 30 ft.
Skills Perception +PB, Stealth +PB
Damage Resistances necrotic, poison
Languages Deep Speech, any languages you know
Consume Potential. When a non-humanoid creature damages the Archon or forces the Archon to make a saving throw against an ability, attack, or feature, it can use its reaction to store the knowledge of that ability, attack, or feature within the Archon Form for later use. This ability can't be used to copy or store spells or the effects of spellcasting. Stored abilities, attacks, and features use your Vessel Spell save DC. The Archon can only store one such ability at once. As an action, the Archon can unleash a stored ability, attack, or feature from itself, using it as the original creature would have. Once used, that ability, attack, or feature is instantly expended. If unused, stored abilities carry over between Archon transformations.
Elder Thirst. When the Archon gains temporary hit points from an Iridescent Strike, it can add them to any temporary hit points it has instead of replacing.

6.name: Primordial Memory
description: At 6th level, the abilities of your Archon form have grown. Your Archon can use Consume Potential to store a number of abilities, attacks, or features equal to your Constitution modifier.
If you consume a new ability while your Archon Form is at its maximum, you can choose which ability to replace.
Finally, when you use an ability you gained from Consume Potential, you can expend a Vessel Magic spell slot to use the ability without losing the knowledge of how to use it.

14.name: Complete Absorption
description: Starting at 14th level, your ability to absorb the power of others shields you from harm. When you use Consume Potential, you can expend a Vessel Magic spell slot as part of the reaction to succeed on the saving throw and gain resistance to any damage. This benefit only applies to the triggering ability or attack.

18.name: Ascendant Mimicry
description: At 18th level, your power allows your Spirit to walk in the material world once again. Your Archon Form gains the following benefits:

• You assume the true appearance of your Parasite Spirit.
  • You can use your Primordial Mimicry feature to retain the knowledge of an ability without expending a spell slot a number times equal to your Constitution modifier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest
  • You can expend a use of this feature to use your Complete Absorption feature without expending a spell slot.

subclasses.name: Parasite

description: Within you dwells the soul of an ancient sage who dedicated their life to mastery over their mind, body, and soul. However they came to dwell within your soul, you can now draw upon the knowledge and battle prowess of this ancient warrior.
Familiar Types: Celestial (astral)

1.name: Enlightened Soul
description: Starting at 1st level, the legendary sage bound to your soul infuses you with their knowledge of martial arts, granting you the benefits below:

• You can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action.
  • You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Acrobatics, Insight, Medicine, or Religion.

1.name: Mystic Techniques
description: By 3rd level, precise mastery over your body, mind, and soul allows you to learn Mystic Techniques. You learn two techniques of your choice. You learn additional techniques as you gain levels in this class, as shown in the table above. You can learn a Technique if your Vessel level meets the Monk level prerequisite, and you use your Charisma ability score in place of Wisdom.
You gain a number of Ki Points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1), and you regain all of your expended Ki Points whenever you finish a short or long rest.

1.name: Enlightened Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 force damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

3.name: Enlightened Archon
description: You take on the luminous form of the ancient sage that is bound to you. Your Archon Form uses the stat block below.  While transformed, your creature type changes to Celestial (astral).

Enlightened Archon
Armor Class Bonus +1
Speed 40 ft., climb 30 ft.
Skills Acrobatics +PB, Insight +PB
Damage Resistances poison
Condition Immunities diseased, poisoned
Languages Celestial, and any languages you know
Master of the Way. Once per turn, when the Archon uses a technique you know, it can reduce its Ki cost by 1, to a minimum of 0.
Swift Strike. Whenever the Archon takes the Dodge, Dash, or Disengage action, or uses its action to use a technique, it can make a single Iridescent Strike as a bonus action on that turn.

6.name: Masterful Pivot
description: Starting at 6th level, you can unbalance a creature's Ki when they strike at you. When a creature you can see misses you with a melee attack, you can use one of the following reactions:

• You force it to make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it is knocked prone and has its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its turn. Any creature that is at least one size larger than you has advantage on its saving throw.
  • You can make one Enlightened Strike against the creature.

14.name: Tranquil Spirit
description: At 14th level, you can draw on the power of the sage bound to you to find success in times of great need. Whenever you are forced to make a saving throw, you can expend 1 Ki Point to add your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1) to the result of your roll.
You cannot do so if you are already adding your Charisma modifier to the triggering saving throw.

18.name: Ascended Sage
description: At 18th level, you and the Sage Spirit bound to your soul have become one creature. Your Archon form gains the following benefits:

• You assume the appearance your Sage had in life.
  • You cannot be charmed, frightened, or paralyzed.
  • Your walking and climbing speeds increase by 20 feet.
  • Whenever you transform into your Archon Form, you also regain all of your expended Ki Points.

subclasses.name: Sage

description: Sealed away due to their lust for violence, Savage spirits are most often demonic in nature, and desire nothing more than bloodshed for its own sake. The vessels of these evil spirits can draw on their power to increase their own marital ability, but risk losing themselves to a supernatural lust of violence.
Familiar Types: Fiend (demon)

1.name: Savage Soul
description: Starting at 1st level, your savage spirit gives you an imposing presence.  You gain proficiency in Intimidation.

1.name: Savage Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in spiritual power and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning damage. The reach of these strikes is 10 feet.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

3.name: Savage Archon
description: You take on the twisted form of the savage demon that is bound to you. Your Archon Form uses the stat block below.  While transformed, your creature type changes to Fiend (demon).

Savage Archon
Armor Class Bonus +1
Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft.
Skills Athletics +PB, Intimidation +PB
Damage Resistances fire, poison
Condition Immunities diseased, poisoned
Languages Abyssal, and any languages you know
Dual-Mouthed. Your Archon manifests two mouths, which can be used to cast spells. When the Archon casts a spell that requires an attack roll, it gains a +2 bonus to its roll if it cast the spell from its mouth.
Four-Armed. Your Archon manifests four arms, each of which can be used to make unarmed strikes and grapple. When the Archon hits a creature with a Savage Strike, it can use a bonus action on that same turn to attempt to grapple it with another arm. Creatures that begin their turn grappled by the Archon take 1d4 slashing damage.

6.name: Sinister Vigor
description: Starting at 6th level, the savagery of battle drives you into a frenzy. Whenever you score a critical hit with a Savage Strike or you reduce a creature to 0 hit points you have resistance to all damage until the start of your next turn.
Moreover, while you are in your Archon Form, you have advantage on Savage Strike attacks against any creature that is grappled by you.

14.name: Savage Domain
description: At 14th level, you can unleash the cursed power within your soul, bending your environment to your will. As an action on your turn, you can exude cursed magic in a 30-foot radius. Creatures of your choice within that radius treat the area as difficult terrain and take 1d6 necrotic damage if they begin their turn there. For every consecutive turn a creature starts its turn within this radius, this necrotic damage increases by 1d6.
This feature lasts for up to 1 minute, until you lose your concentration (as if you were concentrating on a spell), you are incapacitated, or you end it as a bonus action.
Once you use this feature you must finish a long rest before you can use it again. If you have no uses remaining, you can expend a spell slot to use this feature again.

18.name: Cursed Savage
description: At 18th level, your power allows your Spirit to walk in the material world once again. Your Archon Form gains the following benefits:

• You assume the appearance of your Savage Spirit.
  • You can make two additional Savage Strikes each time you take the Attack action on your turn.
  • The damage from your Four-Armed feature becomes 2d4.
  • The damage dealt by your Savage Domain becomes d10s if you use it while you are in your Archon Form.

subclasses.name: Savage

description: While most creatures seek to improve and change, there are ancient primordial spirits that seek the opposite. Beings such as these are called The Stagnant, elder creatures who desire nothing more then to crawl back to the ancient nothingness from which they came, taking the world along with them.
Familiar Types: Aberration (astral)

1.name: Void Strikes
description: You can draw on the Spirit sealed in you to strike with otherworldly power. When you make an unarmed strike, you can cloak the strike in endless night and use your Charisma, in place of Strength, for the attack and damage rolls. On hit, these special unarmed strikes deal 1d6 necrotic damage.
The damage die of these strikes increases at certain Vessel levels: 5th level (1d8), 11th level (1d10), and 17th level (1d12).

1.name: Unchanging Form
description: Starting at 1st level, within you is sealed a being of stagnation and unchanging power. You cannot have your form changed against your will, and you have advantage on any saving throw you are forced to make to resist the effects of a transmutation spell.
Additionally, you gain resistance to necrotic damage.

3.name: Stagnant Archon
description: You draw on the unchanging being sealed within your soul to transform into a primordial form. When you transform into your Archon Form you use the Stagnant Archon stat block below.  While transformed, your creature type changes to Aberration (astral).

Stagnant Archon
Armor Class Bonus +3
Speed 25 ft., climb 25 ft.
Skills History +PB, Intimidation +PB
Damage Resistances acid, necrotic, poison
Languages Primordial, any languages you know
Entropic Aura. The Archon exudes a force of ancient stagnation. Creatures of your choice within 10 feet must must roll a d4 and subtract the result from any ability check or saving throw it is forced to make.
Reversion. When the Archon hits a shapechanger or a creature under the effect of a transmutation spell with a Void Strike, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or revert to its true form or have the spell dispelled. Once a creature succeeds on this save it is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

6.name: Aura of Stagnation
description: At 6th level, the power you are able to draw out from your Sealed Spirit has grown. The radius of Entropic Aura increases to 15 feet.
Moreover, the area within your Entropic Aura now counts as difficult terrain for creatures of your choice within it.

6.name: Fetid Touch
description: Also at 6th level, your Stagnant Spirit longs for the draining of life, especially that of creatures from which it has already tasted. You have advantage on Void Strike attack rolls against creatures under the effect of your spells.

14.name: Call of the Void
description: Starting at 14th level, your Sealed Spirit feeds on the decay and degradation of the world around it. When you deal necrotic damage to a target while in Archon Form, your temporary hit points increase by an amount equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
Also, the radius of Entropic Aura increases to 20 feet, and creatures must subtract a d6 from their rolls while within it.

18.name: Fundamental Reversion
description: By 18th level, your power allows your Spirit to walk in the material world once again. Your Archon Form gains the following benefits:

• You assume the true appearance of your Stagnant Spirit.
  • You resist all bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
